newsitems.title: 'Don't blame yourselves' for Destiny 2's end, community lead tells players: 'No words can accurately depict how lucky we are to have shared these worlds with you'
newsitems.author: Andy Chalk
newsitems.contents: Destiny 2Destiny 2 has reached the end of the line: The final update is live, TWIDs are over, and we're all left wondering how the one-time king of live service shooters has come to such ignominious ruin. Even Destiny's competitors are baffled by Sony's decision to pull the plug, although some say Sony's not the real villain here at all. If there is a villain, besides Bungie management—which I think we can all agree has been pretty consistently not great—one thing's for sure: It's not Destiny players... Read more.

newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d1ef0da1959ac5b383fbf357a2b9af071015cef5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Season 04 Reloaded: Incoming Intel[/u][/h2][p][/p][h3]Lock Into Summer[/h3][p][/p][p]This summer, there’s no break in the heat as an unexpected hero leads the action across all four modes. Unlock and play as Nick Cage across new and returning Multiplayer maps and modes guaranteed to make you sweat. But it’s not time to cool off yet. End The Guild’s dominance in Avalon once and for all in Endgame’s new Operation King Killer, fight in a Japanese feudal castle engulfed by lava in the new Kowakujō Round-Based Zombies map and prove your status as an elite action hero with the return of the Champion’s Quest in Core Battle Royale.[/p][p][/p][p]Summer’s heating up and with Season 04 Reloaded, the temperature is downright sizzling. Gear up and face the inferno when the Mid-Season update arrives in Call of Duty®: Black Ops 7 and Call of Duty: Warzone™ on June 25 at 9AM PT across all platforms.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="W824eTd2bFc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Endgame Content[/u][/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]FREE TO PLAY: ENDGAME CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Operation King Killer:[/b] The Guild’s defenses are down as JSOC breaches the company firewall. Pinpoint the location of the Central Command Node and destroy it in Operation King Killer, delivering ten escalating challenges in Zone III and higher. Unlock new rewards and complete the Operation with Samuels, Wei Lin, or Emma Kagan to earn a new Weapon Camo, and with all three to access a new Animated Weapon Camo.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Skill Track, New Skills & Minor Ability:[/b] Stand up to the most punishing combat encounters with the new Guardian Skill Track, transforming your Operator into a frontline anchor. Unlock a new Exotic Skill and Nightmare Skill and brain-rot your foes with the hallucinogenic effects of the new Psych Grenade Minor Ability.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Free to Play Continues:[/b] Play Endgame for free through the end of Season 05. Invite your friends to join the squad and level up and earn rewards through the co-operative game mode’s multiple Operations.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Act IV: Operation King Killer (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9e682a5f328205e200d13939823a1c66eb8516de.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Time to end this, once and for all. The Guild’s Central Command Node has been revealed. Collect Command Data throughout Avalon to pinpoint its source and destroy it.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]In Act III, The Guild struck back against JSOC’s attempts to deploy a virus against their network, but through the efforts of Operators on the ground, the location of the Central Command Node was finally revealed. With the Guild network now fully exposed, it’s the perfect time to strike.[/p][p][/p][p]But it won’t be easy. From Step 1, Operation King Killer kicks things off with missions in Zone III or higher, starting with vehicular combat as Operators scour Avalon for anomalous data and other intel sources to help track down the location of the physical terminal housing the Command Node.[/p][p]  [/p][p]Earn new rewards as you complete the various Operation objectives, all while further empowering your Operator through additional CR gains.[/p][p] [/p][p]In the final step, acquire access to the new Prime Target Glitch and face the Glitch Boss. Operation rewards include a new Weapon Blueprint, Emblem, Double XP Token, Restore Token, Loading Screen, and more, detailed below. [/p][p][/p][p]Defeat the Glitch Boss, Earn Rewards[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ddd3ed9d09968f6ed4561ca034bf5dbb03d9ec45.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Reach the final step of Operation King Killer to gain access to the Prime Target Glitch. Beat back a flood of enemies in a Nightmare Difficulty zone culminating in a ruthless boss fight.[/p][p][/p][p]Defeat the Prime Target Glitch Boss in the final step with Samuels, Wei Lin, or Emma Kagan to earn the unique “Data Freeze” Operator Skin.[/p][p][/p][p]Act IV Completion Rewards: [/p][list][*][p]Earn 1 “Data Freeze” Operator Skin to unlock the “End of Daze” Weapon Camo.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Earn all 3 “Data Freeze” Operator Skins to access the “End of Dayz” Animated Weapon Camo.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Operation King Killer Rewards[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/62334b016428ec541250afb481dc7ab965af74b4.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]“Decompression” Weapon Charm and 1,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Restore Token and 1,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1 Hour Double Player XP Token and 1,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Last Breath” Emblem and 2,500 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1 Hour Double Battle Pass XP Token and 2,500 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Upper Limit” Large Decal and 2,500 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1 Hour Double Weapon XP Token and 5,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Dutybound” Loading Screen and 5,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Hot Hands” Emote and 5,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Coolant Leak” Weapon Blueprint, “To the Grave” Animated Calling Card, and 7,500 XP[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Guardian Skill Track, Psych Grenade, and More[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/249e5ed57dcb5975fb5f22468edacdaa74782e48.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Since the launch of Season 04, Operators have been decimating Guild and hallucinatory forces across Avalon wielding the new Death Machine Major Ability. In the Mid-Season, shrug off heavy attacks with the new Guardian Skill Track and inflict brain-rot on foes with the new Psych Grenade. Position the lingering cloud near chokepoints and enemy groups for maximum effectiveness.[/p][p][/p][p]Skill Track: Guardian[/p][p][i]Stand your ground and turn pressure into power. The Guardian skill track makes you a frontline anchor, shrugging off damage, punishing attackers, and sustaining both yourself and your squad. With stronger defenses, better resource drops, and proximity-based revives, Guardians do not just survive the fight, they control it.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Payback:[/b] Enemies that damage the player receive damage themselves.[/p][p][b]Battle Cache:[/b] Increased chance to spawn an Ammo/Armor Resupply pack when eliminating an enemy.[/p][p][b]Power Tap:[/b] Picking up Ammo/Armor Resupply packs also grants Equipment recharge.[/p][p][b]Fortified:[/b] Reduce incoming damage for every currently equipped plate. The more plates equipped, the bigger the damage reduction.[/p][p][b]Iron Grip:[/b] Reduce hip fire bullet spread and reduce flinch when getting hit.[/p][p][b]Rescue Pulse:[/b] If allies are downed, the player can revive them just by being near them. If the player goes down, other players can revive them just by being nearby.[/p][p][/p][p]New Minor Ability: Psych Grenade[/p][p][i]Explodes on impact, releasing a lingering cloud of hallucinogenic gas that brain-rots enemies.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]New Exotic Skill: Fission[/p][p][i]Killing an elite has the chance to trigger a large explosion, dealing massive damage to nearby enemies.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Upgrade this new Exotic Skill for increased damage and radius of your explosions and deploy a final upgrade to spawn friendly Toxic Fears from those explosions.[/p][p][/p][p]New Nightmare Skill: Sleeper Agent[/p][p][i]Chance on hit to turn base enemies into allies that rush nearby hostiles and detonate on impact.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Upgrade the newest Nightmare Skill to attract enemies to the Sleeper Agent, and with a final upgrade, the Sleeper Agent will drop cluster munitions to expand the damage radius.[/p][p][/p][h3]Free to Play Through Season 05[/h3][p][/p][p]Endgame will remain free to play until the end of Season 05. Jump in and dominate across Avalon while powering up your Operator with unique combat abilities that encourage you to push into more challenging zones. Play now to earn Weapon Camos, Operator Skins, and other in-game rewards.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Black Ops 7: Season 04 Reloaded Multiplayer[/u][/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]MULTIPLAYER CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Multiplayer Maps:[/b] In Zenith, deploy to a luxurious cliffside compound where a bloody handprint marks a secret passage to the running water below. Plus, prepare for Launch, originally released in the original Call of Duty: Black Ops and newly remastered for Black Ops 7![/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Multiplayer Modes:[/b] Adapt or die in Team Blueprint Sharpshooter where Weapon Blueprints rotate throughout the match, testing your ability to change tactics on the fly while gaining bonuses for elimination streaks. For a close-quarters challenge, drop the ranged weapons and compete in Knife Fight. Black Ops Classic also becomes a permanent addition, with four more maps added to the rotation.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Multiplayer Maps[/h3][p][/p][p]Zenith[/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6/2v2, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0592d0d275ce8b777b15d2f5d2fc1193a44e98ea.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In a last-ditch effort to reverse JSOC’s gains, The Guild assaults Karma’s sanctuary hidden deep in the jungle. The extravagant compound features everything the expert hacker needs, from state-of-the-art tech and security systems to high end art and breathtaking architecture. In the aftermath of the attack, an armored vehicle lies burning and overturned at the Entrance, a trail of blood leading into the main Office.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/53c24623955f2c9802d3fd990241fdf9d6634545.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Fight within the building or enjoy the view along the main flanking paths on either side, whether you’re traversing the edge of the cliff or taking the upper ground. For greater concealment, try your luck in the running water beneath the compound… but get out when the alarm starts blaring and the red lights flash, a sure sign that you’re about to get swept off the brink.[/p][p][/p][p]Launch[/p][p][i]Remastered, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9829aa0026b2e5e3392a443b507a51c4966d69ec.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Deploy to a Russian rocket launch facility in Launch, returning from the original Call of Duty: Black Ops. At the start of the match, witness the massive rocket being lifted and moved into position over the Launch Pad, preparing for takeoff near the halfway point of the match. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/eee462a542b61da428f6938268b0aed568b8d02d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In addition to the Loading zone and Launch Pad, the sprawling facility includes an expansive Fuel Yard, Storage, and the main Road connecting various supporting structures and interior spaces. The complex layout of industrial features provides plentiful cover points and flanking paths and prime sniping spots up the Launch Pad staircases. No matter what your playstyle, there’s a place for it here. Gear up, drop in, and prepare for takeoff.  [/p][p][/p][h3]Multiplayer Modes[/h3][p][/p][p]Team Blueprint Sharpshooter[/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f62afd4e9005856c855095944f81d49b66921052.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Weapons cycle every 45 seconds. Eliminate enemies to earn score. Earn bonus abilities and 2x score for elimination streaks.[/p][p][/p][p]Adapt and slay in this 6v6 playlist featuring cycling Loadouts with Weapon Blueprints like the Heart-Stopper NX Ravager, Search Party MPC-25 SMG, the dual-wield Deadend Coda 9 Pistols, and other incredible Blueprints across the Primary, Secondary, and Melee Weapon slots.[/p][p][/p][p]Push the attack and earn power-ups for kill streaks, speeding up your combat movements and unlocking a double score multiplier at a five-streak. The exact Operator bonuses are as follows: [/p][p][/p][p]1-Streak: Faster movement speed.[/p][p]2 -Streak: Faster reload speed.[/p][p]3-Streak: Faster sprint recovery.[/p][p]4-Streak: Faster aim down sights speed.[/p][p]5-Streak: Double score.[/p][p][/p][p]Use every tool at your disposal and don’t forget that Equipment renews with every weapon swap as well. Toss your throwables, open fire, and be the first team to reach the score limit to win the match.[/p][p][/p][p]Knife Fight[/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1867d27302e1a9417a1a92a0deacb7b55b9d745d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Eliminate all enemy players using pre-determined classes to win the round. No respawns.[/p][p][/p][p]Engage in 2v2 hand-to-hand combat in this close-quarters variant of Gunfight. From the H311-SAW to the Flatline MK.II and, naturally, the Knife and Ballistic Knife, Knife Fight challenges Operators to engage in an epic melee brawl.[/p][p][/p][p]There are no Scorestreaks or Field Upgrades here, and ranged weapons are restricted except for the Equipment items granted to players a few seconds into the round and the Ballistic Knife when it’s chosen as the round’s main weapon. newsitems.title: PNC 2026: Pride & Glory
newsitems.author: Eoin
newsitems.contents:
[p][b][i]PNC 2026 is about to kick off! Here’s what you need to know about the top contenders, according to guest columnist and caster Jisuboy.[/i][/b][/p][p]Team pride and honor are on the line. For the users who enjoy PUBG and the viewers who love esports, wouldn't this be considered the most special moment of the year? The PUBG Nations Cup (hereafter PNC), which began at Jangchung Arena in 2019, is looking ahead to its 6th edition this year. This PNC 2026 will feature a total of 24 teams and is expected to be the biggest and most special event yet. And at the center of it all, many of you must be wondering which team will ultimately lift the trophy.[/p][p] [/p][p]Today, let's take a look at the most likely championship contenders for PNC 2026.[/p][p][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260622/CHvdpneA.jpeg" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: inline-block; float: none; margin-left: 5px; margin-right: 5px; min-width: 10px; vertical-align: bottom; border-width: medium; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: initial; text-align: center;"][/img][/p][p][b]\[Natus Vincere Assemble - Ukraine][/b][/p][p]The comrades who parted ways in the past have returned and reunited. In the past, when Hakatory was heavily dominating in international tournaments, there was the formidable backup fire of someone who was keeping their eyes wide open. Many players fell to their knees before them. However, unfortunately they couldn't ultimately secure a championship, leading them to part ways and walk their own paths. Quite some time has passed, and they have reunited as the representatives of the Ukraine team for PNC 2026. The joining of DIFX, who used to be the reliable turret for Natus Vincere (hereafter NAVI), can be considered the strongest imaginable combination for Ukraine. [/p][p]It is no exaggeration to say that Ukraine’s roster is practically NAVI itself. There are already three players from NAVI, and DIFX has a history of building synergy with NAVI for a long time. If Feyerist takes charge of the overall macro and team direction, Hakatory and boost1k will stand at the very front to shake up enemy lines, while DIFX operates the match by providing support fire from the back. Because the individual mechanics of the players are excellent, they mostly engage in gunfights that rely on raw aim, and their win rate is incredibly high.[/p][p]In particular, Hakatory, who secured the "Man of the Match" title 9 times in the 2026 PGS and firmly established himself as the undisputed best fragger in the world, has quite good synergy with the rising rookie fragger, boost1k. In this PNC 2026 as well, when a scenario arises where these two are dominating, if DIFX fills in the empty gaps, it naturally makes you wonder: who could possibly beat this team?[/p][p]Of course, as I have repeatedly mentioned in previous columns, their greatest weakness is their squad preservation. When analyzing the metrics of the 2026 PGS, if there is one glaring aspect about NAVI, it is that their revival count is extremely low. Across 70 Final Stage matches, they recorded a total of 52 revives, averaging 0.74 per match, showing poor resilience. This means that when a team fight breaks out, their combat power leakage is severe. The average revival count of the teams that won the 2026 PGS was 1.52 per match; compared to that, their figure drops to almost half. If opponents specifically target the moments when Ukraine's knock feed pops up, they can force them to fail their recovery and collapse.[/p][p][b]ACE - Hakatory
[/b]The number one candidate for the World's Best Gunner. From 2025 to now, it is safe to say almost no one can match his offensive power. Even the Emperor of Europe, xmpl, has to take a backseat; his gunplay alone is top-tier. However, because he is as fiery as his shots, his body often pushes too far forward, resulting in frequent early eliminations. Since Thailand's Best Gunner, KISS, has recently leveled up his weight class, a head-to-head clash between the two is highly anticipated.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260622/lOdRyOhG.jpeg" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: inline-block; float: none; margin-left: 5px; margin-right: 5px; min-width: 10px; vertical-align: bottom; border-width: medium; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: initial; text-align: center;"][/img][/p][p][b]\[USA][/b][/p][p]PNC 2024 was held in South Korea. The South Korean team won by a narrow margin, but the point difference at the time was exactly 1 point. If the Brazilian team hadn't kept them in check, South Korea's victory might not have happened. 10th place in 2019, 9th in 2022, 7th in 2023, runners-up in 2024, and 4th in 2025. This is the USA team.[/p][p]Looking at the main roster of the USA team, Shrimzy and Kickstart, who have consistently participated since 2022, stand out the most. Both have served as the main artillery for their team, Falcons, and they lack absolutely nothing in representing the USA team this time. Mid-to-long-range shooting is their specialty, and Shrimzy, in particular, has always shown great performances in international tournaments for many years, making him an undeniable target of caution.[/p][p]Born in 1993. The Professor. PurdyKurty, who holds the nickname "Professor," has taken the baton holder of the USA team since PNC 2024 and showcases solid macro in every match. Earning his nickname thanks to his precise grenade throwing abilities, if you evaluate him solely on throwing skills, he boasts a phenomenal level that ranks in the top five globally. He primarily uses a macro pattern of calmly occupying choke points and, once the grenade distance is reached, destroying the opposing team with throwables to seize the victory.[/p][p]It is no exaggeration to say that Cowboi, who was newly selected as a representative for the USA team this time, was chosen for his outstanding individual mechanics. His play of entering key strongholds of the battlefield first, holding out, and winning is remarkable. He enjoys the playstyle of constantly shaking up other teams from the front while receiving mid-to-long-range support fire from his teammates, and his value will soar to its peak in this very tournament.[/p][p]With overall good balance and a characteristic calmness, the USA team is expected to record a high placement in this PNC 2026 as well. If they aim for third-party events of other teams or slightly elevate their aggressive tendencies, I think they have enough power to fully aim for the championship this time.[/p][p][b]ACE - Shrimzy
[/b]If asked to pick just one player in the USA who is the most stable and consistent, Shrimzy is definitely the first to be chosen. He is great at infighting and boasts explosive firepower at mid-to-long ranges. However, compared to the performance he has shown on the international stage so far, he has been slightly shaky recently, so the key is how much his condition has recovered. I look forward to seeing if he can rebuild the faltering prestige of the USA team.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260622/jniUswwD.jpeg" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: inline-block; float: none; margin-left: 5px; margin-right: 5px; min-width: 10px; vertical-align: bottom; border-width: medium; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: initial; text-align: center;"][/img][/p][p][b]\[The First Trophy - China][/b][/p][p]The Chinese team achieved their best result—runner-up—since participating in PNC last year, but even that probably wasn't satisfying for them. And understandably so, because the absolute elite members of the Chinese team were fully mobilized. This year, the one who rose to be the world's best (MMing) is gone, and the unprecedented genius (Aixleft) has also suddenly left. However, I can say that my prediction makes this the scariest Chinese representative team ever, and their chances of winning are higher than ever before.[/p][p]For a long time, many Chinese teams showed strength in the Asian region but often looked poor or inconsistent on the international stage. But there is a player who, based on years of international experience, has participated in almost every international tournament and delivered results. Not having a championship win on the international stage was the only flaw in his career, but he overcame even this by winning the PGS series. Now, the only tasks left for him are winning PNC and PGC. Who is it? It's the story of China's greatest commander, Lilghost.[/p][p]First of all, this player's judgment in taking good spots at the right timing and adjusting the pacing of defense is phenomenal. Because of this, all teams clearly know the methods he uses, yet cannot easily breach them. There are no openings. Even if they manage to create an opening and deal damage, Lilghost reinforces that very weakness in the next match. How can you fight against an opponent who unconditionally holds the upper hand in mind games?[/p][p]What about throwables? His team, 17Gaming, boasts world-class accuracy in throwing abilities. Grenades thrown together perfectly on time and dropping exactly in the right places bring down even impregnable fortresses. After weakening the enemy with precise throwables, they send in a general to dominate the battlefield. His teammate, xwudd, perfectly executes that role without hesitation.[/p][p]17Gaming's xwudd flaunted his skills not only in the regional tournament, PCL, but also by never backing down in any international tournament he participated in. Beyond mere individual mechanics, he is exceptional at reading the opponent's psychology, neutralizing countless fraggers. If you run into this player, you might as well abandon the thought of walking away unscathed. His close-quarters combat sense is innate, and you literally cannot beat him unless you risk everything. He can easily be called the Best Gunner of the Central Plains. He is a player who can personally prove why he was selected as a Chinese national representative for 3 consecutive years.[/p][p]With great overall macro, and joined by SpaceMan, the MVP of 2026 PGS1, the momentum of the Chinese team for this PNC 2026 is extraordinary. Furthermore, three of the Chinese representative players belong to the same team, 17Gaming, and since their coach, Akuma, is also taking the helm for the Chinese team, strategy formulation and player management are much smoother compared to other teams. The first PNC trophy is getting closer to the Chinese team.[/p][p][b]ACE - tiantian
[/b]Among the newly selected Chinese representatives this year, 17Gaming's tiantian, along with xwudd, can be picked as the most feared player. He claimed the final MVP in the regional PCL tournament this year and maintained top-tier stats in PGS as well. His combat sense is so excellent that he doesn't fall short compared to xwudd, and if I had to name his biggest strength, it's that his proficiency with literally every weapon is extremely high. If you ask players what their main weapons are, they would generally answer an AR/DMR combo, but this player doesn't discriminate. AR, DMR, SR, Shotgun, M249, Panzerfaust, Mortar—once he gets his hands on them, they simply turn into lethal killing machines. In particular, the accuracy of the mortars he fires is often absurdly precise, making him a figure requiring extreme caution. If China wins this tournament, tiantian will likely be standing at the vanguard.[/p][p][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260622/bTR4ce9N.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: inline-block; float: none; margin-left: 5px; margin-right: 5px; min-width: 10px; vertical-align: bottom; border-width: medium; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: initial; text-align: center;"][/img][/p][p][b]\[KISS the Trophy - Thailand][/b][/p][p]The recent momentum of the Thai teams is unusual. Just last year, FULL SENSE (hereafter FS) won PGC 2025, and in 2026 PGS, Made in Thailand (hereafter MiTH) won twice. Perhaps because of this, looking at the lineup of this Thai representative team, you can see it is composed of terrifying players. Having achieved good results in PNC, they have caught the perfect opportunity to relieve their past sorrows.[/p][p]Thailand's best long-range shooter, Belmoth, showcased outstanding mechanics in last year's PGC. When the matches ended, he led the team to the championship, was selected as the final MVP, and became the owner of the Porsche everyone coveted. Because he delivered massive performances at crucial phases, possesses exceptionally brilliant shooting skills, and is equipped with composure, he has joined the Thai representative team for the first time in a while since his selection in 2022.[/p][p]TiGGER is a player with the world's best aggressive tendencies. He is adept at catching other combat events during a match, often inflating his explosive stats through hit-and-run tactics. Furthermore, his close-quarters infighting skills are so outstanding that if this player's knock feed pops up nearby, every team must put their guard on high alert.[/p][p]When weighing the contributions to MiTH winning this 2026 PGS 6, Scappy's share is substantial. His indoor defense is a masterpiece, and because he pursues plays entirely free of greed, he ranked 2nd overall in survival time, becoming the epitome of stability. He is expected to properly fulfill the role of Thailand's final gatekeeper.[/p][p]Since two FS members who led the PGC victory last year and two MiTH members who are showing a fantastic start in '26 have joined forces, expectations are high. However, because FS's performance this year hasn't been great, the key is whether they can overcome the main players of other teams that have generally leveled up. Additionally, since the macro directions of their respective teams are distinctly different, it will be interesting to see how this team bridges that gap.[/p][p][b]ACE - KISS
[/b]A perfect hexagon player who combines flawless infighting, innate combat sense, pressure plays through throwing setups, and composure on the big stage, along with deep respect for his teammates. If I had to pick just one player currently recording the highest stock value, it would probably be Thailand's Best Gunner, KISS.[/p][p]From his debut, this player's skills have been extraordinary. He frequently ambushed and assassinated from spots enemies never expected, and the victims were mostly top-class players with world-class mechanics. Being where he shouldn't be, and not being where he should be, leaves the victims completely helpless.[/p][p]This player is scary when roaming alone, but is far trickier when playing with the strict backup of his teammates. Not only does he rarely go down even under heavy fire, but he plays while precisely recognizing the angles from which his teammates can support him, allowing him to pour his focus entirely into one place. Going a step further, he perfectly pictures the structures and covers of buildings in his head while playing, making his throwing accuracy ghost-like.[/p][p]You want to know his weakness? Unless Thailand's team play completely breaks down, or KISS gets a stomachache on match day and his condition severely drops, this player shows no weaknesses. If you want to win this PNC 2026, you must crush Thailand's Best Gunner, KISS. If not, you will find yourselves watching KISS literally kissing the PNC trophy.[/p][p][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260622/nhqVf10A.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: inline-block; float: none; margin-left: 5px; margin-right: 5px; min-width: 10px; vertical-align: bottom; border-width: medium; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: initial; text-align: center;"][/img][/p][p][b]\[The Golden Star of PNC - Vietnam][/b][/p][p]PNC until now has been a continuous chaos where no one knew who would win. There was even a time when a team won by a hair's breadth of 1 point. Even when the point gap was large, it was around 30 points. But 2025 was different. The point difference between 1st and 2nd place was a staggering 61 points. It was a truly overwhelming gap. No one could bring them to their knees. Both their macro and their combat were close to perfect. The defending champions of PNC: Vietnam.[/p][p]Since participating in PNC, the Vietnam team has never dropped outside the top 4. Vietnam team's legendary coach, DjChip, remains. Moreover, not a single player out of those who lifted the PNC 2025 trophy has changed. Excluding TanVuu, 4 members including the coach currently belong to the same team, Anyone's Legend, and considering Captain Delwyn's previous home team, it's safe to say they are practically the same team.[/p][p]This team's macro is simple. Captain and main IGL, Delwyn, preoccupies a good spot, and the teammates prefer the method of clearing the outskirts with raw power before joining up. If there is a unique trait to this player, it is his outstanding ability to develop positions or rotation routes that others rarely use, and even if he dies early, his post-death shotcalling is so good that it immensely helps his teammates grasp the battlefield. He is undeniably the world's best brain.[/p][p]TanVuu is a player building the ultimate career, winning PGC in 2024 and PNC in 2025. Being able to attach a star to the Vietnam uniform came from this player's incredible survival instincts and combat sense. Hanging alone on a Miramar cliff, wiping out countless enemies, and personally eliminating the fiercely pursuing South Korean team—that player is TanVuu. In fact, during the last PNC 2025, he proved he is an exceptional player by securing 1st place in total kills and 2nd place in total survival time, competing for the final MVP with Vietnam's greatest superstar, Himass.[/p][p]Recently, Solozy has also been raising his momentum in the 2026 PGS, with his condition peaking. This player's strength is his high understanding of all weapons and his flawless, clean movements. He utilizes mortars and Panzerfausts at the perfect times, taking on the role of carving out a path for the team, and his success rate is phenomenal.[/p][p]However, looking at their recent match records in 2026 PGS, some inconsistent fluctuations have occurred, so the rivals facing the Vietnam team must not miss the flow to push forward. They must absolutely not give this team the moment to regain their rhythm. The moment you give them an opening, you will not be able to stop the Vietnam team, equipped with explosive combat power and smart macro abilities.[/p][p][b]ACE - Himass
[/b]This player can be called the icon and superstar of Vietnam. In his 4th PNC appearance, Himass possesses the qualities to become the greatest player of all time. He overcomes numerically disadvantageous situations with his own combat sense, and in particular, his AR first-bullet accuracy is so razor-sharp that he rarely loses in AR head-to-head duels. During PNC 2025, in order to eliminate just Himass left on a balcony, four German representatives rushed him, only to almost get wiped out themselves. In terms of sheer AR skill alone, I'd bet he easily ranks in the top five globally. Furthermore, because this player is also excellent at shooting the Lynx AMR, dropping your guard just because it's long-range can blow up the match itself.[/p][p]Now, the Vietnam team is eyeing the South Korean team, which holds the record of two PNC championship wins. But can they really stop this player by sheer force? If they fail to stop this Vietnamese monster, they will just have to watch as a second star gets engraved on the red uniform.[/p][p][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260622/d250WXzZ.jpeg" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: inline-block; float: none; margin-left: 5px; margin-right: 5px; min-width: 10px; vertical-align: bottom; border-width: medium; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: initial; text-align: center;"][/img][/p][p][b]\[Spear, Shield, Commander, Captain - South Korea][/b][/p][p]There is a team that secured runner-up in 2019, 4th place in 2022, won in 2023, and secured back-to-back championships in 2024. However, in 2025, they finished in 8th place, failing to achieve the massive milestone of three consecutive championships. The National Representative Selection Committee was formed once again, picking the best players. This is the South Korea team.[/p][p]What they considered the most important in this South Korea team selection was balance. First, they needed the sharpest spear to neutralize other teams at the absolute frontline of the battlefield. The one who took on the role of that spear was the flame-like frontline fragger of T1: Heather (Ji-hoon Cha).[/p][p]From around his debut, Heather is a player who has produced countless highlight reels and boasts a high win rate even in 1vsMany fights. He quickly grasps the advantage/disadvantage of a fight, never missing a setup that favors him, and being proficient in all weapons, if you leave it to him, he has the ability to wipe out an entire squad in an instant. Even compared side-by-side with the aces of other regions mentioned above, he is a player who lacks absolutely nothing. Despite his young age, born in just 2005, his ability to never shrink on the big stage is also considered a strength.[/p][p]If you have a spear boasting sharp offensive power, you can't be without a shield, right? Across all players globally, Heaven (Tae-sung Kim) has the least variance in performance, is considered the ultimate hexagon player, and was the leading figure in the two PNC championships. It is hard to find him in poor condition, and he showcases legendary performances every time he competes.[/p][p]Ironically, when this player shines the brightest is when the team is in a critical crisis. It's no wonder he earned the nickname "South Korea's Best Shield." Whether it's throwables, close-range, or long-range, he plans to protect his teammates with his heavy shots and blinding clutch saves.[/p][p]Next, a commander was needed to tune the overall flow of the match. Consistently delivering results in international matches, and possessing a career unmatched by anyone at the domestic level, the main IGL of DN Soopers (DNS), Gyumin (Gyu-min Shim), was the perfect fit.[/p][p]Gyumin excels at accurately reading the situations of other teams and proposing the team's next scenario. Not only that, but he also frequently displays outstanding combat abilities—a crucial virtue for modern main IGLs. Holding his breath, he accurately sprayed AR first bullets to take down countless players. He is a talent equipped with both brawn and brains.[/p][p]And, of course, there had to be a Captain to tie the South Korean players together. A whopping 9 years since his debut. Born in '95. Age is just a number. Even at this very moment, he is still growing: SeongJang (Jung-hwan Seong) took the captain's armband.[/p][p]SeongJang's greatest strengths are his tuning and throwing abilities. When the main IGL ponders and selects among multiple scenarios in a match, he has the insight to modify it so that it becomes the ultimate best scenario, and his perfect throwing abilities forged by 3rd-person play make impossible breaches possible. He is also adept at grasping the surrounding combat situations, making his Kill Steal (KS) abilities exceptional.[/p][p]While their overall raw combat power might lag slightly behind other regions, considering their ability to read the situation and flow at crucial moments, the overall fighting power of the South Korea team looks second to none. I'm curious about the final result of the South Korea team boasting perfect balance.[/p][p][b]ACE - Heaven
[/b]If we only look at flashiness or super plays within a match, players from other regions might look more dazzling. But at the most perilous moments, the player who made a collapsing team hold on and eventually stand back up was always Heaven. The reason the South Korea team could attach two stars. At the center of it, he always stood. A player who has silently proven himself through his gameplay for the team's victory. South Korea's Guardian Deity, Heaven, is now looking toward a third star that no one has ever reached.[/p][p][b]Conclusion[/b][/p][p]What kind of tournament is PNC to you? To some, it might just be a simple event match. But heading into a match carrying the expectations, pride, and honor of countless fans cheering for you is not a common occurrence. Some step onto the battlefield to write a new history, some to reclaim lost glory, and others to prove their own value. This once-in-a-lifetime moment. In this historic scene, whose journey will you cheer for?[/p][p][i]- Jisuboy[/i][/p][p][/p]

[h2][b]The PUBG Nations Cup 2026 kicks off with Survival Stage Day 1![/b][/h2][p]PNC 2026 will take place from June 23rd to June 28th in Seoul, Republic of Korea. Survival Stage Participants[/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,,"][tr][td][p]Argentina[/p][/td][td][p]Australia[/p][/td][td][p]Canada[/p][/td][td][p]Denmark[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Finland[/p][/td][td][p]United Kingdom[/p][/td][td][p]India[/p][/td][td][p]Japan[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Kazakhstan[/p][/td][td][p]Malaysia[/p][/td][td][p]Neutral Team[/p][/td][td][p]Norway[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Philippines[/p][/td][td][p]Chinese Taipei[/p][/td][td][p]Turkiye[/p][/td][td][p]Ukraine[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3][b]Tournament Format[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]PNC 2026 will be played across two stages — the Survival Stage and the Grand Finals — with 5 matches per day.[/p][list][*][p]Survival Stage: 2 days / 10 matches total[/p][/*][*][p]Grand Finals: 3 days / 15 matches total[/p][/*][/list][p]Of the 24 competing teams, the top 8 from PNC 2025 will begin their journey directly in the Grand Finals, while the remaining 16 teams will battle for 8 Grand Finals slots during the Survival Stage.
[/p][h3][b]\[Grand Finals – 8 Teams][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Defending Champion: Vietnam[/p][/*][*][p]Brazil, China, Germany, Indonesia, Korea, Thailand, United States of America[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]\[Survival Stage – 16 Teams][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Argentina, Australia, Canada, Chinese Taipei, Denmark, Finland, India, Japan, Kazakhstan, Malaysia, Neutral Team, Norway, Philippines, Türkiye, Ukraine, United Kingdom[/p][/*][/list][p]The top 8 teams from the Survival Stage will join the Grand Finals to form a final field of 16 teams. The PNC 2026 champion will be crowned based on cumulative points across the three days of the Grand Finals.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Tournament Ruleset[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Scoring: PUBG Esports S.U.P.E.R Point System[/p][/*][*][p]Maps: Erangel, Miramar, Taego, Rondo[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]\[Map Order][/b][/h3][p]Survival Stage[/p][list][*][p]Day 1: Erangel → Miramar → Taego → Rondo → Erangel[/p][/*][*][p]Day 2: Taego → Erangel → Rondo → Miramar → Taego[/p][/*][/list][p]Grand Finals[/p][list][*][p]Day 1: Erangel → Miramar → Taego → Rondo → Erangel[/p][/*][*][p]Day 2: Taego → Erangel → Rondo → Miramar → Taego[/p][/*][*][p]Day 3: Erangel → Miramar → Taego → Rondo → Erangel
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]\[Competitive Settings Update][/b][/h3][p]To deliver a more compact and fast-paced match flow, PNC 2026 will be played with adjusted Blue Zone settings.[/p][list][*][p]Shorter early Blue Zone phases: reduced duration for Phases 1 and 2[/p][/*][*][p]Shorter final Blue Zone phase: reduced duration for Phase 9[/p][/*][*][p]Removal of Land Ratio option: Land Ratio option has been disabled for Phases 4 and 8[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted circle size: overall reduction in circle radius to match the shorter match length[/p][/*][/list][p]These adjustments will apply to the PNC 2026 competitive environment and are expected to deliver an even more dynamic and exciting match flow.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Prize Pool & Crowdfunding[/b][/h3][p]PNC 2026 kicks off with a base prize pool of $500,000. 25% of the revenue from the PNC 2026 Event Pass, set to launch alongside the tournament, will be added to the total prize pool through crowdfunding, helping make PNC 2026 an even more rewarding stage for all participating teams.
[/p][p]The total prize pool will be distributed according to each team's final ranking, and both the prize money and sales revenue share will be distributed equally among each team's roster. Further details on the Event Pass, including release schedule and lineup, will be shared in a separate announcement.
[/p][p]* The Event Pass is not available on Console.
[/p][p]** However, 25% of the individual sales revenue from items included in the Event Pass will be added to the crowdfunding total in the same manner.
[/p]

newsitems.title: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ: Explore the Hajin Exclusion Zone
newsitems.author: COD Official
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7a2c6a6d871e593d678a2da9f416c05df5d961a7.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]DMZ // Overview[/h2][p align="start"][i]A High-Stakes, Action-Packed Extraction Shooter[/i][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]DMZ is [i]Call of Duty[/i]’s definitive extraction shooter, a living world with unpredictable enemy encounters, weather, and objectives all brought together by meaningful match-to-match progression and inventory systems. Whether you plan to infil solo or with a squad, this volatile conflict zone offers numerous paths to choose from.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fbb2b156cfa462836f7fdda8d2f28f9e511eefe5.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]After experimenting and getting player feedback from the original DMZ Beta, [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]evolves the extraction shooter into a deeper, more cohesive, and more persistent combat experience shaped by what resonated most with players. Set in the Hajin exclusion zone and tied directly to the events of the Campaign, players deploy into a volatile Exclusion Zone, choosing how to survive, whether pushing deeper into dangerous territory for greater rewards, hunting high-value targets, defending against escalating enemy threats, completing story missions, or extracting before the situation becomes untenable.[/p][h2] [/h2][h2]DMZ // Setting[/h2][p align="start"][i]Into the Exclusion Zone[/i][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]SUMMARY: Enter a contested exclusion zone as an off-the-books asset tasked with securing advanced military technology before it falls into hostile hands. [/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5ca7111264241a5f195dfac25dfddd1dfd52bba2.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Following the events of the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Campaign, an exclusion zone across the Korean peninsula remains saturated with abandoned military technology, weapons stockpiles, and destabilizing threats. Operating as a shadow CIA asset, you are deployed behind enemy lines and tasked with securing the various weapons and technology left behind before they fall into enemy hands. Both Rogue Operators and enemy combatants are active throughout the zone, forcing every squad to decide when to cooperate, when to engage, and when to disappear before tensions escalate.[/p][p align="start"]Loot, fight, negotiate, betray, and extract whatever you can carry.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]DMZ // Setting // Hajin: The New Frontline[/h3][p align="start"][i]A Region Shaped by Conflict[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Hajin is a dense exclusion zone built around exploration, discovery, and high-risk player-driven operations, where environmental storytelling and hidden discoveries reward players willing to push deeper into the unknown.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/11401a19332b87c5d97b958236390e79aab4789f.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Nestled within a tri-point region bordering Russia and the Korean peninsula, Hajin is a contested exclusion zone where rival forces battle for control of abandoned military technology and strategic assets left behind after the events of the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Campaign.[/p][p align="start"]The atmosphere within the Hajin Exclusion Zone shifts can change based environmental effects, creating new opportunities and challenges on every run. Sudden downpours can reduce visibility and force Operators to adapt how they explore, move and engage, while dense fog banks and overcast skies transform familiar routes into tense navigational gambles.[/p][p align="start"]Scarred by radiation, mass evacuation, and the collapse of civilian infrastructure, the region is one of the largest and most ambitious Call[i] of Duty[/i] environments ever built, designed around exploration, environmental storytelling, and high-risk operations. From the irradiated Fallout reactor and the highly secured Prison complex to the remains of Hajin City and the heavily defended Military Base, every region inside the border area and exclusion zone offers different combat opportunities, sealed or hidden areas waiting to be discovered, traversal challenges and points of interest with hidden entrances accessible only via water, and other operational risks. Players willing to push deeper into the unknown can uncover hidden secrets, pursue high-value gear, and engage in increasingly dangerous missions with greater risks and rewards.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]DMZ // Operations // Story Missions[/h2][p align="start"][i]Operations Pushing the Narrative Forward[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Continue the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] story through narrative-driven Story Missions built for replayability, squad-based action, and evolving storytelling throughout live seasons.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/98fbd9003e450d9b54f78a0d7efec3004cc0aae1.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]A collection of Story Missions expands the narrative of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], and features unique objectives, high-stakes action, and gameplay scenarios unfolding inside specific points of interest across Hajin, all within a live DMZ server populated by other operators pursuing their own missions. Built for squads and solo players with replayability in mind, Story Missions push the broader DMZ narrative forward through new discoveries and fresh challenges over time.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]DMZ // Operations // Dynamic Operations, Side Ops and Free Roam[/h3][p align="start"][i]Activities that Evolve Every Match[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Take on guided Operations featuring evolving scenarios, escalating threats, and climactic moments unique to every match.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/eec6fc961d0f785244bbf3563e3632c0a8479112.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Before deployment, your objectives in DMZ are clearly defined: a focus on Story Missions, engaging in Dynamic Operations, and free explorations across Hajin. But no plan is guaranteed to last. The unpredictable nature of DMZ often demands quick adjustments as situations evolve in the field. Whether you decide to stay covert or bring the fight directly to your enemies, every match is an opportunity to push deeper into Hajin, uncover valuable intel and hidden secrets, and hunt down rogue enemy Operators to build your infamy.[/p][p align="start"]Dynamic Operations are multi-step objectives generated for each match and designed to create focused tasks, from neutralizing abandoned weapons programs and securing critical assets to high-risk rescue operations and assaults against hostile forces. Every Operation in this extraction shooter is built around escalating tension, replayability, and large-scale moments capable of impacting activity across the wider region.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/76d2a11d899832f1eae3078145264a0186f7ace1.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Even a seemingly routine task can lead to intriguing exploration: Side Ops are available and include activities like locating trucks across Hajin that have advantageous functionality once they’re repaired, locating lost supply drops, or scaling damaged radio towers. There’s the freedom to explore like never before, even into sectors of extreme danger like the area of heavy fallout in the eastern part of the map, where it takes a gas mask and gumption to find loot only available in this point of interest.[/p][p align="start"]Beyond these Operations, Hajin supports free-roaming exploration for players who want to forge their own path, preserving the open-ended freedom that defines the DMZ experience. Whether hunting rival Operators, scavenging for resources, hunting down dangerous Lieutenants, accessing phones to initiate Dynamic Operations, commandeering a derelict casino while attempting to break into the vault without attracting a rival squad’s attention, or simply surviving long enough to extract, these side tasks add unpredictability and player choice.[/p][h2] [/h2][h2]DMZ // A Living World[/h2][p align="start"][i]Low and Slow or Fast and Loud[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Rival factions, roaming patrols, and shifting world events ensure that no two operations unfold the same way.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d132c5d789778a8e64513eff003cf3c722eca6c7.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Players decide how to approach Hajin — moving low and slow through hostile territory, risking everything with an aggressive assault, or something in-between — while dynamic world systems respond to every action. Vehicle convoys move across the roadways, air traffic fills the skies, and hostile forces constantly reposition WMDs and strategic assets. With enemy factions and rival human squads battling for control of key locations, every operation can evolve in unexpected ways. Hajin represents an extreme opportunity for exploration.[/p][p align="start"]DMZ also benefits from the advancements in movement and combat systems introduced in [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], including enhanced traversal options like climbing pipes and navigating environmental obstacles with fluidity, alongside refined weapon handling, ballistic authority, and other mechanics that carry across the broader game experience.[/p][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][h3]DMZ // A Living World // Emergent Enemies[/h3][p align="start"][i]Advances in Enemy Combat Intelligence[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Improved AI combatants allow for larger combat spaces with coordinated enemy squads, reactive combat behaviors, and more dynamic infantry and vehicle encounters.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6f4cd320b29df6c1234c37dcfb53e1ac15eec0d5.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]Modern Warfare 4 [/i]brings a new level combat density beyond anything seen in Call of Duty before. Hostiles throughout the exclusion zone are guarding key areas, traveling in convoys, flying in choppers and moving in large squads.  New squad generation systems help AI adversaries move beyond individual enemy behavior, with units that coordinate, navigate, react, and pressure players more convincingly. Approach lone AI enemies, and expect them to take cover and hold position, freeze, or try to break your line of sight. Combined with advances in game engine physics and squad/vehicle interactions, these systems make combat feel more active and unpredictable, opening the door to new forms of emergent gameplay.[/p][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][h3]DMZ // A Living World // Escalating Threats[/h3][p align="start"][i]Push the World, and it Pushes Back[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Escalating threat levels trigger stronger enemy responses, increasingly dangerous reinforcements, and elite forces sent to hunt players down.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/845feceac2caaf5138d7c73b6d5c77705daadd3c.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Hostile threats across Hajin range from ruthless Lieutenants leading specialized units to roaming commander enemies that include tanks, drone swarms, Deathstalker helicopters, Juggernauts, and Elite Strike Teams. The DMZ threat system tracks player activity and escalates enemy responses as operators attract increasing attention inside the region. As threat levels rise, enemy forces mobilize to reassert control, deploying increasingly dangerous reinforcements to hunt players down. These forces include attack helicopters, more dangerous and heavily armored troops and eventually enemy Deathstalkers being dispatched to chase you down.[/p][p align="start"]Survival depends on more than firepower alone; success comes from strategy, adaptability, and controlling the pace of combat before the engagement spirals out of control. One of these ways is using the Stealth Meter, a system that assists Solo players particularly well, as it helps you control combat when facing AI enemies. If you’re close to being spotted by AI adversaries, expect an audio cue and an indicator on your HUD that changes from white to yellow to orange. Hit the deck or get back into cover to prevent the observing hostile from being alerted.  [/p][h3] [/h3][h3]DMZ // Progression // FOB[/h3][p align="start"][i]Forward Operating Base[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: A hub between operations, your FOB can be upgraded to unlock new services, expand operational capabilities, and prepare your squad for future deployments.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/20863df32fe99346cc6cc8892005973123ed3cc6.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Before and after every extraction operation inside the DMZ, players return to their Forward Operating Base (FOB), a central hub built around preparation, progression, and long-term squad support. The FOB gives players access to key operational services including the 3D Printer crafting station, The Stash where inventory items can be stored deployment to deployment, weapon purchasing, a firing range, bounty boards, and additional upgrade systems that unlock over time. It also serves as a staging ground and social hub where squad members can regroup, rearm, inspect their Operators, assist with onboarding newer players, and prepare before deployment. As players earn XP, complete Missions, progress through the Trait System, gaining the reputation and skillset of an elite Tier 1 operator over time, the Forward Operating Base evolves alongside you, unlocking new functionality while visually transforming to better support your growing capabilities.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]A Tour of Your Forward Operating Base[/i][/p][p align="start"]The FOB is the operational backbone of DMZ. Access the following via the physical FOB spaces and streamlined menu navigation. Note that imagery of the FOB will be unveiled at a later date.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Orders and Objectives:[/b] Track your active Missions, review completed objectives, check available completion rewards, and plan future operations before heading back into the field.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stash and Loadout:[/b] Between deployments, players can manage a persistent inventory containing weapons, equipment, consumables, valuables, and special items. Gear can be organized between your Stash, and your Active Duty Operator's Backpack and Loadout. Each Active Duty Operator has their own Backpack and Loadout. The Stash size can also be upgraded by ranking up in DMZ. Operators looking to infil immediately can choose a Free Loadout containing combat essentials.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wallet: [/b]Use in-game cash primarily to purchase weapons and Gunsmithing attachments, as well as rescuing MIA operators, paying for Lieutenant Intel and much more.[/p][/*][*][p]Completing Missions and Ops is the primary source of cash, wired directly to the Wallet in the FOB. Expenditure of funds is a key consideration in DMZ, and players may wish to employ an Active Duty Operator as a cash mule with particular skills when breaking into vaults, defeating HVTs (or other Bounty-tagged human prey) or completing Dynamic Ops to earn cash.[/p][/*][*][p][b]3D Printer:[/b] Gather resources throughout Hajin and return them to the FOB’s crafting station: As a general rule, the 3D Printer is capable of manufacturing a vast array of functional equipment and support gear (with a detailed list later in this blog), excluding Primary, Secondary, and Melee weaponry. Recipes unlock the ability to use component resources to craft a wide variety of Gear; items like night vision goggles, ballistic vests, backpacks, consumables, Killstreaks, and other specialized Equipment.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gunsmith: [/b]Weapons and related attachments are purchased using Cash in Gunsmith. The more effective the weapon or attachment the more expensive they are. As you progress through Mission Orders and extract Weapon Manuals from Hajin, the option of purchasing the weapons directly becomes available, but initially you'll have to rely on weapons scavenged during deployments. You can use cash to modify weapons with attachments you've unlocked, including Apex Attachments, but each one has a cost: suppressors, extended mags, powerful optics, and more all cost extra for the added effectiveness.[/p][list][*][p]The Gunsmith allows you to add up to five Attachments to a weapon, along with an Apex Attachment. However, eight-Attachment weapons have been confirmed within Hajin.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon Progression tracks across Multiplayer and DMZ.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Weapon Vendor: [/b]DMZ Operators with enough in-game cash can purchase additional specialized weaponry from the FOB’s military supplier. These weapons are added directly to your Stash. The selection is limited and rotating, refreshing after a period of real-time has occurred. If you’re after a professionally built armament and don’t have the time to extract or purchase a gun and modify it, or use the Gunsmith, then this is an excellent option. Weapon Vendor firearms can be adjusted just like scavenged or purchased weapons, and don’t negatively affect your looting or progression.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Firing Range (First Person):[/b] Located adjacent to the Gunsmith and Vendor, the firing range allows Operators to test Primary and Secondary weapon builds in a dedicated first-person training environment.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Active Duty (Operators):[/b] Manage your available Operators, including those awaiting recovery after failed exfils. Each Operator maintains their own persistent Backpack, persistent Loadout, and persistent Trait Tree. This mission readiness allows players to prepare specialized kits for different deployment styles. Operator Traits (see below) can also be managed here.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss Board:[/b] Review the latest intel on hostile Lieutenants (LTs); high-ranking enemy targets operating throughout Hajin before you drop into a match and attempt to neutralize these targets. Here, you can pay for intel related to a particular Lieutenant that allows you to pinpoint their location more accurately and reach them before your rivals do. Or climb Hunt Towers across Hajin, accessing a terminal to receive intel on the closest Lieutenant to your location. Slay a Lieutenant, and they drop a set of Dog Tags.[/p][list][*][p][b]Lieutenant’s Dog Tags: [/b]Exfilling with these spoils of combat helps populate your Boss Board and are helpful to your continued success as an LT killer. However, they are equally valuable to enemy squads, who can track you via any Lieutenant’s Dog Tags you’ve acquired during a match. Expect fierce resistance from rival teams attempting to appropriate your LT’s Dog Tags, usually at hot exfil points, so they can populate their own Boss Board.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Bounty Leaderboard: [/b]Monitor the most dangerous rival players currently operating inside the Exclusion Zone.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Deploy:[/b] Before deploying into Dynamic Operations or Free Roam your squad can choose how to infil with the Paid Infil System. Go in quiet on foot, or fast and loud in a helicopter or large plane. Do you have the need for a vehicle dropped with you? The game has got you covered.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]DMZ // Progression // Active Duty Operators[/h2][p align="start"][i]Build Your Specialized Squad[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Recruit and customize a roster of specialized Operators while earning progression through every operation inside the DMZ.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bea52286d5ea8d1fd5e2c71d4cf5a9a404011766.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]DMZ features a dedicated progression system built around a persistent inventory and long-term Operator growth. Within the FOB’s “Active Duty” menu, players can create multiple Operators as the Active Duty slot system returns from DMZ Beta, with each Operator owning a backpack and loadout persistent through multiple deployments, and customize them through the Trait System, assembling a roster of professional recruits suited for different mission types and playstyles. The more players accomplish during an operation, the more XP and progression rewards they earn, encouraging more risk-taking and deeper exploration. These multiple layers of progression provide a deep and rewarding experience:[/p][list][*][p][b]Global Player and DMZ XP: [/b]Story Missions, Dynamic Operators, and Side Ops are all excellent methods of obtaining XP, along with additional activities and enemy takedowns.[b] [/b]This is irrespective of whether you successfully exfilled or not; there are no XP penalties for dying during a match.[/p][/*][*][p][b]DMZ XP:[/b] All XP earned in DMZ upgrades your FOB, unlocks new Stations in your FOB, and ranks up your Operator. This allows you to unlock game-changing Traits to customize your playstyle..[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]The Trait Operator Progression System[/i][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Within the Active Duty station of the FOB, players can spend earned Trait Points on individual Operators to improve their effectiveness across a variety of disciplines, utilizing them from a roster of persistent characters. Earn Trait Points during missions and invest them into one of three Trait Trees, each leaning into a different skillset related to combat, scavenging, and other capabilities. Points are tied to the Operator who earned them. Unlock Traits along with passive benefits that allow you the freedom to specialize individual Operators for specific roles, including proficiency in PvP engagements, infiltration, looting, recoveries, or as a cash mule.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]DMZ // Progression // Looting[/h3][p align="start"][i]Supplies Where They Should Be[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Search for weapons, equipment, and crafting materials placed naturally throughout the region based on location and strategic value.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/42f0a23fc40e779805097849b97c8ed96c16fafa.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Looting is a core part of progression in DMZ, built around meaningful resource gathering that rewards players who learn the region, study the map, and understand where valuable resources might be found. Finding unique ingredients in Hajin becomes a major focus, especially as you learn recipes – combinations of ingredients allowing the creation of better gear. Hunting for rarer ingredients that build more powerful equipment like printing Killstreaks, improved Plate Carriers, or Backpack types, and searching for recipes that upgrade your 3D printer to enable you to print even more potent items, results in a much more meaningful looting experience.[/p][p align="start"]Supplies and loot are primarily distributed in ways that feel grounded and logical within the world itself, encouraging smart exploration and decision-making. Police stations contain combat gear and tactical equipment. Hospitals may have scarce medical supplies. Residential districts offer valuable crafting resources and scavenged materials. Designed to minimize inventory friction and keep players focused on the action, the looting system emphasizes player agency, preparation, and risk-versus-reward.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]DMZ // Progression // Crafting[/h3][p align="start"][i]Build the Gear You Need[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Gather resources throughout Hajin and use the upgraded 3D Printer system to craft equipment, weapons, and high-end gear.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/eba9d776f3200d19c586f4fd9f931b0a5bba8db7.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Crafting gives players greater control over how they prepare for future operations by transforming recovered resources into valuable equipment and combat-ready tools. Materials are disassembled automatically during a mission so players can stay focused on the action, while inventory management is easy to navigate. Extracted loot can be used back at your FOB within an intuitive crafting system built around a powerful upgradable 3D Printer capable of unlocking increasingly advanced crafting options, allowing players to manufacture equipment and rare gear.[/p][p align="start"]The categories of Gear you can 3D print are as follows:[/p][p align="start"]Here are the categories of Gear:[/p][list][*][p][b]Gear:[/b] Tactical equipment such as NVGs and Parachutes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Backpacks:[/b] Packs of varying sizes and specializations carried into a match.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Plate Carriers:[/b] Craft different types of armor vests.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tacticals:[/b] Stock up on strategic, non-lethal equipment.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lethals:[/b] Assemble offensive equipment designed to damage or eliminate threats.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Consumables:[/b] Beneficial items, from pain killers to radiation blockers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Field Upgrades:[/b] Abilities providing tactical support or intelligence. Unlike Multiplayer, Field Upgrades in DMZ do not recharge.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fire Support Items:[/b] Deployable offensive killstreak support.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tracked Recipes:[/b] A series of tagged recipes you’re on the hunt for.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Special Items:[/b] A wide variety of items used for a wide variety of purposes.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The deeper players push into the region, the more opportunities they uncover to secure rarer resources needed to support stronger loadouts and specialized playstyles.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]DMZ // Progression // Weapon Condition and Variants[/h3][p align="start"][i]Equipment Shaped by Conflict[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Recover damaged weapons and rarer enemy variants shaped by the harsh realities of the exclusion zone.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]After combat, players can scavenge for dropped armaments, many with damaged optics, broken attachments, unstable weapon components, and improvised field repairs that affect both appearance and handling. High-value lieutenants also carry uniquely customized weapons featuring attachments and camouflage finishes.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]DMZ // Progression // Recovery Systems[/h3][p align="start"][i]Extract. Or Die Trying[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Failed extractions carry real consequences, but recovery systems ensure players can continue progressing and return to the fight.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1d4e0aeafeb799c3c028b1039746efb22ca1a8ee.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Though squads have multiple options to exfil from Hajin from helicopters to skyhooks, not every deployment ends in success. When an Operator is downed, they may be rescued, left to fend for themselves, or become lost in action. Fortunately, there are additional options:[/p][p align="start"][b]Tourniquet: [/b]A new survival mechanic is the Tourniquet, allowing you to heal to a wounded state if you don’t have self-revive equipped. You won’t last long after a Tourniquet application, so you’ll need to apply additional medical items to reach full health.[/p][p align="start"][b]MIA System: [/b]For those lost in action, the new MIA system allows players to expend in-game cash at the FOB and deploy rescue teams to recover them and continue their progression without starting from scratch. DMZ is designed to preserve the tension and high-stakes risk that define extraction shooter gameplay while remaining a little more forgiving than traditional extraction experiences. Every infil is still a gamble, with valuable rewards, equipment, and resources on the line until you successfully extract. While failed operations carry meaningful setbacks, players continue earning XP, unlocking rewards and traits, and advancing long-term progression. Every deployment moves you forward, but greater success still demands skill and tactical judgment.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]DMZ // PvP[/h2][p align="start"][i]Hunter or Hunter Killer[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Take down rival Operators, build notoriety, and climb the Bounty leaderboard as the hunt escalates.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/285149140ea1bac657ce5d14eaf7419252ad5307.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]The hostile forces occupying Hajin are dangerous enough, but they’re not the only threat in the Exclusion Zone. Other squads or solo players are also deploying into Hajin, adding an unpredictable human element to every operation as players compete for valuable objectives and extraction opportunities. Every encounter carries uncertainty, forcing squads to decide whether to engage. For players who thrive on competition, DMZ’s Bounty system turns every engagement with rival Operators into a risk-versus-reward decision. Hunting other players raises your notoriety and puts a price on your head, making you more visible and easier to track. As a player’s notoriety grows, successful hunters can become some of the most dangerous targets inside Hajin. Earn a place on the infamous Bounty leaderboard by becoming a notorious killer or a bounty hunter. Secure rival dog tags and successfully extract for substantial payouts, along with serious bragging rights. Every Operator eliminated raises both the rewards and the dangers of operating inside Hajin, though hunting bounty targets can lessen the target on your own back.[/p][p align="start"][b]Proximity Chat: [/b]In these high-tension situations, where life and death hang in the balance, you’ll need to stay frosty and employ vocal communication to end an engagement either peacefully, or with a satisfactory kill. With an upgraded engine comes a revamped Proximity Chat, allowing you to listen to (or mute) rival Operators within the vicinity of you or your squad, along with the following improvements:[/p][list][*][p][b]Distance-Based Vocal Falloff:[/b] Expect to find it easier to hear rival enemies the closer they are to you.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Directionality:[/b] Pinpoint chatter more precisely depending on the direction your foe is approaching from.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Environmental Voice Reverb:[/b] The type of interior structure or exterior topography affects the reverberations and echo of incoming comms, perhaps giving clues to their whereabouts.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]See You in Hajin[/h3][p align="start"]Built on the same foundation powering [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Multiplayer — including refined and fluid movement across maps, an expanded equipment and full complement of weaponry, enhanced gunplay and Ballistic Authority — DMZ brings the full breadth of [i]Call of Duty[/i] combat into a persistent extraction experience.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Stay Frosty[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Additional Intel Incoming[/h2][p align="start"] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/df5080a975ac203fe9a87234bfbcf869d42824d7.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Track the latest official [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] intel on the Call of Duty Blog as we move toward additional information drops, the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Open Beta, and launch on October 23.[/p][p align="start"]For more information on DMZ, be sure to check out additional announcements at the XBOX Games Showcase, as well as the latest episode of the CODPOD, both on Sunday, June 7. Expect further DMZ intel arriving in the weeks and months ahead.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p]Preorders are available now at participating retailers, in-game, on platform stores, or at [url="https://CallofDuty.com"]CallofDuty.com[/url]. For more information on preordering, including Vault Edition content, rewards, and a special Loyalty Discount, [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2026/05/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-preorder-benefits-game-editions-details"]see the Preorder blog here[/url][/u].[/p][h3] [/h3][h3]Development Credits[/h3][p align="start"][i]Call of Duty[/i]: [i]Modern Warfare 4 [/i]development is led by Infinity Ward and will be available globally on PC via Steam on Friday, October 23rd, 2026.[/p][p align="start"][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] for the PC delivers a fully optimized experience, led by Infinity Ward in partnership with Beenox, for Steam.[/p][p align="start"]Additional development in alphabetical order: Activision Central Design, Activision Central Technology, Activision QA, Activision Shanghai, Beenox, Demonware, High Moon Studios, Raven Software, Sledgehammer Games, and Treyarch.[/p][p align="start"] [/p]

newsitems.title: A new Dota 2 update buffs Nature's Prophet and Arc Warden, but everyone's talking about a mysterious Axe 'change'
newsitems.author: editor@pcgamesn.com
newsitems.contents:
Fresh Dota 2 patch notes have just dropped, and that means the meta will start to creak and shift under the weight of Valve's latest balance adjustments. There are some welcome changes in Dota 2 update 7.41d, along with a few that I'm sure people will question, and even a nice quality-of-life buff. The line that's got people talking, however, is a mysterious footnote for Axe that doesn't appear to have any current meaning. Is it a clue hinting at the next addition to the MOBA? My heart tells me yes.

Read the full story on PCGamesN: A new Dota 2 update buffs Nature's Prophet and Arc Warden, but everyone's talking about a mysterious Axe 'change'

newsitems.title: 7.41d Gameplay Patch
newsitems.author: flynnch
newsitems.contents:
[p]Patch 7.41d is out now and you can check out the patch notes [url="https://www.dota2.com/patches/7.41d"]here[/url].[/p]

In addition, we've recently addressed the following issues:
[list]
[*] Fixed Greevils not spawning their equipped effects
[*] Fixed Earthshaker's Planetfall Arcana not tracking combos and combo damage properly
[*] Fixed right click on Dota Labs Overlay Map not working when "Auto-Repeat Right Mouse" is enabled
[*] Fixed Bottle with a stored Rune being able to be moved in and out of the backpack
[*] Fixed Harmonizer not considering abilities with charges on cooldown
[*] Fixed Elder Titan's Astral Spirit's movement speed not taking Wind Lace into account
[*] Fixed Elder Titan's Echo Stomp shard not swapping places with Astral Spirit if he is being moved by another ability when the stomp goes off
[*] Fixed Invoker not receiving an Aghanim's Blessing from Alchemist if Alchemist casts Aghanim's Scepter on Invoker when his main inventory is full but the backpack had space
[*] Fixed Alchemist being able to repeatedly give Invoker Aghanim's Blessings if Invoker hasn't chosen his Aghanim's Scepter upgrade
[*] Fixed Invoker not correctly being refunded for his Aghanim's Blessing if Invoker has not selected an Aghanim's Scepter upgrade and Alchemist casts Aghanim's Scepter on him
[*] Fixed Spirit Bear's permanently consumed items not counting towards Lone Druid's net worth
[*] Fixed Spirit Breaker permanently changing teams when he reflects Venomancer's Noxious Plague with Lotus Orb and then casts Planar Pocket on Venomancer before Noxious Plague spreads, then after it spreads to a neutral creep Venomancer uses Helm of the Dominator on that creep
[*] Fixed Venomancer being able to Transmute Spirit Breaker with Hand of Midas through the same process
[*] Fixed Wraith King's Vampiric Spirit not turning Wraith King into a wraith if he levels up at the same time as dying
[*] Ability Draft: Fixed Forge Spirit starting at too high a level
[*] Ability Draft: Fixed Brewmaster's old Aghanim's Scepter being available
[/list]

After more than six months of stealth development, a super duper secret alpha, and a ton of broken sentry guns, TFCL is back and ready for public testing! TFCL is a North American competitive 6v6 league. Registration for TFCL's Alpha Season 2 opened on May 21st and runs through July 5th!
 
To make things even more awesome, they're throwing a $504 prize pool at this season! And medals, of course. Can't forget those!
 
Alpha Season 2 will last approximately 6 weeks, with an additional week or two for playoffs. There will be 12 matches, two per week, on servers located in North America. Entry is free. TFCL will host and configure all match servers, so all you have to do is sit back, compete, and have fun!
 
More information can be found [url=https://tfcleague.com/alpha2]here[/url]!
