newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2cfac2ca7800e91b1d42af7115e70f83bec622e1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Yours for the Taking: Black Ops Season 04 is Here![/u][/h2][p] [/p][h3]The Story So Far[/h3][p] [/p][p]After David Mason is captured by The Guild and Specter Two goes on the offense with their own man on the inside, Karma's Guild-killing virus is finally ready to deploy... but Dorne has one last card to play. A collision of forces at JSOC's secret jungle hideout will determine the shape of the future.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Season 04 Roadmap[/h3][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5f2ddd972b454b36a052faf67b8076914fbe6310.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Across [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i], Season 04 introduces another massive season of content. Take on Operation Wall Breaker in Endgame, deploy across five new and remastered Multiplayer Maps, hail the return of Fortune’s Keep, fight off the horde in the new Rogue Run game mode set on Ashes of the Damned in Zombies, and much more![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="59AgHBmGozI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Season 04 is yours for the taking. Join the action in this substantial update packed with free and premium content arriving when [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Season 04 goes live on Thursday, June 4th at 9AM PT across all platforms.[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h2][u]Endgame Content[/u][/h2][p] [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]FREE TO PLAY: ENDGAME CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Expanded Operations:[/b] At the start of the season, The Guild strikes back in Operation Wall Breaker, introducing new challenges and rewards alongside the deadly Command Killer Glitch Fracture. In the Mid-Season, keep up the fight in Operation King Killer.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Operator Prestige: [/b]Achieve new milestones in Endgame with the introduction of Operator Prestige. Hit max Combat Rating and Prestige to unlock even more ways to build your playstyle, including an extra Exotic slot, extra Nightmare slot, and a fourth Skill Track![/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Skill Track, Two Abilities:[/b] Make mincemeat out of your foes with the addition of the Death Machine Major Ability. In the Mid-Season, get access to the new Guardian Skill Track and send targets over the edge with the Psych Grenade Minor Ability.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Act III: Operation Wall Breaker (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d5d75fe1f40689821b2b911b2de669999e716dc1.jpg"][/img] [/p][p][i]The Guild strikes back: a Command Node is preventing Karma’s virus from attacking their network. Scour Avalon for enough Mapping Data to locate the Node and take it down.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]The push to infiltrate The Guild’s network has hit a snag, and unless Karma and her allies can find their way past the company firewall, their plans will have been in vain.[/p][p] [/p][p]In Season 04, players must return to Avalon to find the weak link in Guild security, starting with the search for the region’s hidden network hub. Find it, breach the firewall, and gain the permissions needed to successfully access the command center node.[/p][p] [/p][p]Once you’ve breached the command node, it’s time to crack The Guild’s operations wide open. Enter the ensuing Command Killer Glitch Fracture and complete the mission.[/p][p] [/p][p]Defeat the Glitch Boss, Earn Rewards[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1ea98b1519aa15487ab3ba69b1b1bfd5a3cee8f9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Operators who progress through the steps in Act III will earn a bounty of in-game rewards, all while empowering your Operator for the challenges ahead. In the final phase, locate the Command Killer Glitch Fracture to battle through relentless waves of enemies in Nightmare Difficulty.[/p][p] [/p][p]Defeat the Command Killer Glitch Boss with 50/50, Razor, or Faulkner to earn their unique “Shatter Shock” Operator Skins.[/p][p] [/p][p]Act III Completion Rewards: [/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]Earn 1 “Shatter Shock” Operator Skin to earn the “Decay” Weapon Camo.[/p][/*][*][p]Earn all 3 “Shatter Shock” Operator Skins to access the “Visitors” Animated Weapon Camo.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Operation Wall Breaker Rewards[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/df0ca290cb02b4fc40ba0a784047b562201959d5.jpg"][/img] [/p][list][*][p]“Brain Freeze” Weapon Charm and 1,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Restore Token and 1,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1 Hour Double Player XP Token and 1,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Splitter” Emblem and 2,500 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1 Hour Double Battle Pass XP Token and 2,500 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Frost Beast” Large Decal and 2,500 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1 Hour Double Weapon XP Token and 5,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Fractal Cry” Loading Screen and 5,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Forehead Slap” Emote and 5,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Cold Shoulder” Weapon Blueprint, “Terms of Service” Animated Calling Card, and 7,500 XP[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]More in the Mid-Season[/p][p] [/p][p]There’s no time to let up while The Guild is fighting this hard to maintain their dominance in Avalon. In the Mid-Season, get ready to take on Act IV: Operation King Killer, introducing new challenges and rewards. Get more intel when the Season 04 Reloaded blog arrives in the lead up to the Mid-Season.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Introducing Operator Prestige (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/54bbdfc86f184154cbde5013871d0b6868e606c9.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]Starting with Season 04, Endgame Operators with a maxed-out Combat Rating (CR) will gain the option to enter Operator Prestige 1, starting a whole new leveling journey in exchange for greater power. Entering Prestige discards all equipped Skills, resets the Operator’s CR, discards equipped Field Acquisitions, and resets Loadout weapons to their base rarity.[/p][p] [/p][p]From this fresh state, redeploy to Avalon and start upping your CR again. With each Prestige, your Operator will earn access to additional skillsets, including:[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Prestige 1: [/b]Extra Exotic Skill Slot[/p][p][b]Prestige 2: [/b]Extra Nightmare Skill Slot[/p][p][b]Prestige 3: [/b]Equip a 4th Skill Track[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][h3]Guardian Skill Track, Two New Abilities[/h3][p] [/p][p]At launch, unleash fury on your enemies as the devastating Death Machine joins the list of available Major Abilities. In the Mid-Season, keep your armor and ammo stocked with the new Guardian Skill Track and send foes into a psychotic spiral with the addition of the Psych Grenade Minor Ability.[/p][p] [/p][p]Skill Track: Guardian (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Stand your ground and turn pressure into power. The Guardian skill track makes you a frontline anchor, shrugging off damage, punishing attackers, and sustaining both yourself and your squad. With stronger defenses, better resource drops, and proximity-based revives, Guardians do not just survive the fight, they control it.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Payback: [/b]Enemies that damage the player receive damage themselves.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Battle Cache: [/b]Increased chance to spawn an Ammo/Armor Resupply pack when eliminating an enemy.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Power Tap: [/b]Picking up Ammo/Armor Resupply packs also grants Equipment recharge.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Fortified: [/b]Reduce incoming damage for every currently equipped plate. The more plates equipped, the bigger the damage reduction.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Iron Grip: [/b]Reduce hip fire bullet spread and reduce flinch when getting hit.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Rescue Pulse: [/b]If allies are downed, the player can revive them just by being near them. If the player goes down, other players can revive them just by being nearby.[/p][p] [/p][p]New Major Ability: Death Machine (Launch)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c4e3524cc1797ee944ea5dac20ecfb501217e187.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Deadly machine gun. High damage per shot and large magazine capacity.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p]New Minor Ability: Psych Grenade (Mid-Season)[/p][p] [/p][p][i]Explodes on impact, releasing a lingering cloud of hallucinogenic gas that brain-rots enemies.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Endgame's free-to-play period will extend to the end of Season 05, so bring your friends and jump into all the new content waiting for you in Avalon! If you haven't tried Endgame yet, now's the perfect time to start earning all the Weapon Camos, Operator Skins, and additional rewards the mode has to offer.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Black Ops 7: Multiplayer Content[/u][/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]MULTIPLAYER CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Multiplayer Maps:[/b] At launch, descend into a Guild procedure where the patient’s unstable mind reshapes the map in Liminal, battle within a Japanese game show in Primetime, and watch your step on the remastered Vertigo. In the Mid-Season, play through a map of traps in the new Zenith and activate a rocket on the remastered Launch.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Multiplayer Modes:[/b] Wind back the clock with Black Ops Classic, wield sleek weapons in Blueprint Gun Game, and adapt to your given Loadout in 6v6 Gunfight. Later in the season, cycle through weapons in Team Blueprint Sharpshooter and ditch the ranged weapons in Knife Fight.   [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Additional Loadout Content:[/b] Drop deadly munitions over their heads with the new Iron Rain Scorestreak, a high-altitude, player-controlled aircraft providing a bird’s-eye view of the battle. Upgrade it further with the Active Camo or Tactical Radar Overclocks.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Black Ops 7 Ranked Play:[/b] Get wins and climb the Ranks in the next season of Multiplayer Ranked Play, featuring a completely overhauled transparent Skill Rating system where every point of SR earned and lost is clearly explained in the post-match summary.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p] [/p][h3]Multiplayer Maps[/h3][p][b] [/b] [/p][p]Liminal (Launch)[/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6/2v2, Small-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e41adb763502e9e78dfb7299debb93b6ff9c5dda.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Descend into a live Guild procedure mid-test, where the patient’s response to the experiment actively rewrites the center of the map. When the subject is calm, a red pillar stands intact on a raised platform; when agitation spikes, it fractures and slams into a crater, throwing up fresh cover and new angles around the impact zone.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/71d96c17491b305bf01c5c187bc695a53582f65f.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]When the subject accepts the procedure, the space shifts into a “nature” state, with organic growth reclaiming the central structure and subtly reshaping lanes and sightlines. Corridors feed the core from both sides, cutting past elevators on one flank and offices on the other, keeping rotations tight and fights constant as the room changes under pressure.[/p][p] [/p][p]Primetime (Launch)[/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0c9098082f493b559e2c1d8b78e40145a527b15a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Let no obstacle stand in your way on Primetime, a new 6v6 Multiplayer map themed around a Japanese game show obstacle course. Battle over speed tracks, Wall Jump across bound pads, and rack up points on the board as Operators weave between supersized crates.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1c2e31f1d5eb5e7db7f00cf9b9b7e1ab8328ba4f.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]Make a splash across the Pool track running over the water, a catapult on either end providing quick access to the middle. To get out of the limelight, head to the close-quarters Backstage or head further out along the southern Cargo path running parallel to the course.[/p][p] [/p][p]Vertigo (Launch)[/p][p][i]Remaster, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e206044cb10042875fd611613237fffdf87bb8f8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]First introduced in [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 2[/i], Vertigo returns fully remastered and ready for action in [i]Black Ops 7[/i]. The map features a new Japanese setting, though the layout will be familiar to veterans of the original.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/745fab79d4f7c4a0bed609fef82180f7b9090ef8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Watch your balance as the wind whips by atop the massive skyscraper, newly refurbished as Guild property. A steep drop-off awaits careless Operators fighting along the outer perimeter amongst the Vents, Utility and Storage sheds, and alongside the Helipad. For sturdier ground, head to the inner walkway connected to the East and West Wing, which funnel players into a tight space with guardrails to keep you from plummeting to your demise. [/p][p] [/p][p]Zenith (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6/2v2, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1ea3a92bed9280ae53acbe127d72cf1424f7f18a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Breach a luxurious cliffside abode in Zenith, a waterfall in the distance and pristine lighting guiding you through the immaculate grounds. Battle inside the building, marveling at the bleeding edge tech and expensive artwork, and check for details on the site intrusion in the Security room.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4e782674c98bc0fab312df57614bedb98cac55e7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For a sneakier approach, traverse the running water below, accessible from the outside and from a secret entrance via the inner Office. Take a good look at the bookshelf to discover the trigger mechanism.[/p][p] [/p][p]Launch (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Remastered, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/341dab6346fd74b04271dcb83664a3371fe9233b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Launch map first introduced in the original [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops[/i] returns![/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/93d26d51350d79805bd076f68260c59af527539f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Deploy to this mid-sized map and fight the enemy team across the industrial facility, including the Fuel Yard, Loading, and the Launch Pad itself. Climb the stairwells to battle around the blast shield or fight below the rocket’s thrusters… just not when it’s taking off.[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h3]Multiplayer Modes[/h3][p] [/p][p]Black Ops Classic (Launch)[/p][p][i]New Mode (Moshpit)[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Wind back the clock in Black Ops Classic, a new throwback mode inspired by classic [i]Black Ops[/i] gameplay. With simplified movement and streamlined Loadouts, this mode focuses on tactical positioning and classic multiplayer fundamentals built on the modern foundation of [i]Black Ops 7[/i]. Jump into iconic throwback maps and core modes including Team Deathmatch, Domination, Hardpoint and Kill Confirmed.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Restrictions: [/b]No Overclock Abilities. No Perk Combat Specialty bonus.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Limited Selection: [/b]Scorestreaks, Perks, Lethal, Tactical, Wildcards, Melee Weapon, Field Upgrades.[/p][p] [/p][p]Blueprint Gun Game (Launch)[/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Every plan needs a good outline. Blueprint Gun Game returns for its [i]Black Ops 7 [/i]debut, challenging players to advance through a lineup of Weapon Blueprints. There are no Scorestreaks or Loadouts involved here, just plain old gun skill. Eliminate players with your weapons to advance to the next weapon.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0d9c0c732e7c098341c8e9321e1d3097728d11f6.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]The first player to earn an elimination with every weapon wins. Eliminate enemies with a melee attack to set them back one weapon in the rotation, and use the intel provided by the persistent UAV to track down your next target.[/p][p] [/p][p]6v6 Gunfight (In-Season)[/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Get ready to up the ante as Gunfight returns with a 6v6 spin. Players begin each round with the same pre-determined Loadout that changes every two rounds. Health regeneration and respawns are disabled, so make your shots count. If neither team is wiped out in the specified time, the Overtime Flag will spawn; capture it to secure the round win.[/p][p] [/p][p]Team Blueprint Sharpshooter (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Grab your squad and drop into Team Blueprint Sharpshooter, the 6v6 Multiplayer mode where Weapon Blueprints rotate every few seconds. Each weapon cycle swaps to the same new weapon for every Operator, testing your ability to adapt fast, fight hard, and push for victory.[/p][p] [/p][p]Knife Fight (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]This time it’s personal. Ditch the ranged weapons in this melee-only take on the fan-favorite Gunfight mode that forces Operators into intense, close-quarters fights.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Additional Loadout Content[/h3][p] [/p][p]Make your move from above. Call in the new Iron Rain Scorestreak to rise high above the field of battle, raining deadly munitions on the enemy team.[/p][p] [/p][p]New Scorestreak[/p][p][b]Scorestreak: Iron Rain (In-Season)[/b][/p][p][i]Weekly Challenge Reward[/i][/p][p][b]Score: [/b]825[/p][p][b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/998da5f5a970e7355a5375f125af3aa53174fa2a.jpg"][/img] [/p][p][i]A high-altitude, player-controlled aircraft that provides a bird’s-eye view of the battlefield, allowing tracking and eliminating enemies from above.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Enjoy a birds-eye view of the action below while using this new medium cost Scorestreak designed to pummel enemy forces from above. When called in by the enemy, reach for your Launcher or run for cover.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Overclock Abilities[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]Active Camo: [/b]Keeps aircraft hidden. Attacking or taking damage temporarily breaks camouflage.[/p][p][b]Tactical Radar: [/b]Reveals and pings nearby enemies to allies. Grants bonus score when marked enemies are eliminated.[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h3]Season 04 Multiplayer Ranked Play[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bdd019930b729c42a1fe67d1e665ac766fa8dcca.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Season 04 Ranked Play Overview[/p][p] [/p][p]Multiplayer Ranked Play gives players the ultimate competitive [i]Call of Duty [/i]experience by offering the same settings, maps, modes, and weapon restrictions used by the Call of Duty® League™.[/p][p] [/p][p]Earn career rewards throughout the lifespan of [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Ranked Play, including Rank Skins and Win Challenge rewards.[/p][p] [/p][p]Ranking System Update[/p][p][/p][p][i]Black Ops 7[/i] Ranked Play is getting clearer in Season 04. The SR (Skill Rating) System has been completely overhauled to remove hidden MMR and instead provide full transparency over every single point of earned or lost SR. In Season 04, your SR gains and losses are driven entirely by your visible Rank and your performance relative to the Rank and performance of other players in the match. Outperform players in your Rank or above you and you’ll continue to climb, but struggle to beat players at your Rank or below you and big SR gains will be harder to come by.[/p][p] [/p][p]SR gains and losses are broken down in detail in the updated Ranked Play Post-Match Summary after each match, so you know exactly what moved the needle. Here are the major changes coming with this SR System overhaul in Season 04:[/p][p] [/p][p][b]SR Gains after Wins[/b][/p][p]The following can be awarded after a Ranked Play win:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p][b]Base Win: [/b]Earn a flat +20 SR for every win, regardless of your current Rank.  [b]Scoreboard Bonus: [/b]Finish among the top 4 players of the match to earn an SR bonus. The higher your Scoreboard position, the bigger the bonus.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Opponent Rank Adjustment: [/b]Receive an SR Adjustment based on the relative Rank of Opponents beaten compared with your current Rank:[/p][list][*][p]Outperform opponents that are higher Rank than you and you’ll receive additional SR bonuses for beating better players.[/p][/*][*][p]However, get beaten by lower Ranked opponents and your SR total for the match will be reduced because you were outperformed by weaker opponents.[/p][/*][*][p]Additionally, outperforming lower Ranked opponents will reduce your SR total for the match because you were expected to perform better than the weaker opponents you beat.[/p][/*][*][p]To maximize your Opponent Rank adjustment and receive big SR gains: prove you belong to a higher Rank by outperforming opponents that are currently in your Rank or are higher Rank than you.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Underdog Team Bonus: [/b]Awarded if you beat a significantly higher-Ranked team, while a [b]Favored Team Penalty[/b] is subtracted if the team you beat was lower Ranked.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]SR Deductions after Losses:[/b][/p][p]The following SR deductions and adjustments occur after a Ranked Play loss:[/p][p][b]Base Loss: [/b]-20 SR is deducted when losing a match in Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, or Diamond Ranks. This Base Loss amount increases for Crimson Rank and above so that players are required to consistently exceed expectations of their current Rank to continue to climb into the highest Ranks and the Top 250:[/p][list][*][p][b]Crimson Rank:[/b] -30 SR per Loss[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]10,000 SR+:[/b] -40 SR per Loss[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]12,500 SR+: [/b]-50 SR per Loss[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]15,000 SR+: -[/b]55 SR per Loss[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]17,500 SR+:[/b] -60 SR per Loss[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]20,000 SR+:[/b] -65 SR per Loss[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Underdog Team Bonus: [/b]Your SR loss for the match is reduced if you lost to a significantly higher-Ranked team. Lose to a lower Ranked team and you’ll receive a bigger SR loss via the [b]Favored Team Penalty[/b].[/p][p] [/p][p]Party Size Restriction Update[/p][p] [/p][p]Back in Season 02, [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Ranked Play introduced Party Size Restrictions that limited players in Crimson and above to two-player parties. This was done to ensure that parties did not give players in the highest Ranks a competitive advantage. However, we’ve seen consistent feedback from players who feel like the current party rules are too restrictive and have impacted their ability to party up with friends in Ranked.[/p][p] [/p][p]Season 04 changes the Ranked Play Party Size Restrictions. Crimson players will now be free to form up to four-player parties without size restrictions. Iridescent and Top 250 players will continue to be restricted to two-player parties to ensure that parties do not give players competing for the top Rank a competitive advantage.[/p][p] [/p][p]Season 04 Ranked Play Rewards[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/be359af1040745b3f9ccd485a50cfc69b5d03ac2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b] [/b]Each season comes with its own seasonal rewards that that can only be earned throughout the duration of that season, including the following Weapon Blueprint, Large Decal, Calling Cards, and Weapon Camos:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p][b]Get 10 Wins:[/b] Pro Issue Far from their idyllic presentation in other forms of Nuketown, this neighborhood is tainted with corruption, and the denizens and their Rad-Hounds are anything but friendly.[/p][p][/p][p]Scour the map for upgrades: Perks, Pack-a-Punch, Mystery Box, the Arsenal, Wall Buys, and anything else you can get your hands on to climb the rounds in a confined location, extending from the cul-de-sac out to Trinity Ave. You might not get out alive, but you can at least take down as many undead as you can with you.[/p][p] [/p][p]Survive as long as you can to earn the following rewards:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]“Population: Just You” Animated Emblem and 1,000 XP (complete Round 10).[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Dead End” Weapon Charm and 2,500 XP (complete Round 25)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Time Out” GobbleGum and 5,000 XP (complete Round 50)[/p][/*][/list][h3] [/h3][h3]Directed Mode: Totenreich (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/223890cb38e435f8d90158dee6bcfb7e6a7684e9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Get extra guidance for the Main Quest on Totenreich as Season 04 brings Directed Mode to the map, delivering on-screen quest steps and a max round cap of 15.[/p][p] [/p][p]Explore the ancient fishing village’s dark past under the shadow of giants while battling new enemies including the undead Viking warrior spirit known as the Necropincer, a trident wielding adversary with a giant crab claw in place of its left arm. Stay tuned for the Season 04 Reloaded blog arriving just prior to the Mid-Season for more.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][h2][u]Call of Duty®: Warzone™ Content[/u][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ded8d295d0f30beb111c545cc63b53b0b76a6f67.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]CALL OF DUTY: WARZONE SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Fortune’s Keep Refresh:[/b] The Resurgence map pool expands in Season 04 as the Fortune’s Keep Refresh arrives. Whether you’re returning to the location or visiting for the first time, this iteration supports the advanced movement mechanics and other features of [i]Black Ops 7[/i] along with a handful of updated micro POIs and other changes.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Modes:[/b] Fight for your slice of Verdansk in the 52v52 Clash mode arriving at launch. In the Mid-Season, be the first squad to cycle through every weapon in Squad Gun Game.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]A New Season in Rebirth Island: [/b]The snow has melted and a new season arrives in Rebirth Island. Hang up your snow gear, enjoy the fresh breeze, and push toward that next victory.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Gameplay Features:[/b] Gain access to a mobile Black Market with the new Shadowlink Contract exclusively available in Fortune’s Keep Refresh. Get safely back on your feet into cover with the Advanced Self Revive, and later in the season, see if you have what it takes to acquire and complete the difficult Champion’s Quest.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Resurgence Ranked Play: [/b]Rank up and earn rewards in a new season of Ranked Play: Resurgence including unique Weapon Camos you won’t want to miss.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][b] [/b][/p][p] [/p][h3]Fortune’s Keep Refresh (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/40332ccc27a7a620a39812f8b07aea4f9a3022dd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]It’s the Fortune’s Keep you know and love, now playable like never before. Revisit your favorite haunts and explore new points of interests with enhanced movement and fresh features that bring a new depth to gameplay. For new and returning players, here’s a review of the major points of interest on the map, followed by a closer look at three updated micro POIs found throughout the island.[/p][p] [/p][h3]The Major POIs[/h3][p] [/p][p]Terraces[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/532f414b9d26c98981aa0718f3ba68e643b51d9f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Surrounded by high walls and buildings, the Terraces are a well-fortified POI with access points out to the northern shore and toward the adjacent Keep. Stay on the move and avoid the central fountain, a focal point for all the surrounding vantage points around it. Use the stairs and vine trellises located all over the area to gain some elevation.[/p][p] [/p][p]Keep[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/15edbe05b7eecd878ff0c3171f855476f6b09c85.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Prepare for a variety of engagement types across the Keep; although the structure is large, its sheer number of corridors and rooms turn a long-distance fight into a short one in seconds. The POI extends to the Keep’s outer walls, so check every corner while approaching the sprawling compound, and use all available intel to track enemy movement within.[/p][p] [/p][p]Gatehouse[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3f209d5c8770564a095ec02b6b388513155a9f9e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Gatehouse is the entrance to the Keep’s primary grounds and sits directly in the center of the island. Surrounded by several other major POIs, it’s a difficult area to control, though the reward is worth the risk if you’re ready for constant engagements around it. Note the nearby sewer entrance for a concealed flanking path, and the Ascender giving access to the top of the Gatehouse battlements.[/p][p] [/p][p]Bay[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/06ed951dcec95910cb62bdc5a76c71dcfea2a198.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Positioned along the eastern shore, the once peaceful Bay is home to beachfronts, cliffsides, and the new Sea Science Aquatic Laboratory. Use the Bay’s lowered elevation to keep out sight from the main roads, and as a reliable access point for watercraft with helipad right next to the boat launch. Don’t miss the cliff tunnels up the dirt path, providing a stealthy approach toward the Keep.[/p][p] [/p][p]Winery[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a6b086196f1126fbb482d81ca551ea8c1f9db0bb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Taking up a significant portion of the island’s east end, the Winery is often contested, whether fighting within the center courtyard or sending out suppressive fire around its perimeter. Note that there are several points of access down into the basement below, a haven from the action above, though be prepared for close-quarters combat should an enemy follow you there.[/p][p] [/p][p]Pier[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4d42973c10909b75c24ac4a11d031fbc346e28db.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Like the Bay POI, the Pier offers a respite from the main action of the island, but that hardly makes it a light walk along the beach. Expect to encounter vehicles traversing the Pier as it is also near a major crossroad. Use the dotted beach terrain and scenery, as well as the cliffside, to escape from tough fights and get into a better position for the counterattack.[/p][p] [/p][p]Lighthouse[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ba302c5def3483f85527864847384ffe544dab4f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Check for snipers when approaching the Lighthouse, an Ascender giving access to its upper platform with views over a significant portion of the surrounding area. The shoreline here is extremely dangerous, with little cover against attacks from above. Instead, consider exploring behind the Lighthouse when traversing the nearby grounds, full of cover points with a tunnel into the cliffside and zipline toward Smuggler’s Cove.[/p][p] [/p][p]Overlook[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bb8248af12e1f8600098e0812c6980bf00a5284a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Overlook provides a powerful vantage point over the Town and its surrounding areas. The section closest to Smuggler’s Cove features a high-end restaurant with a picturesque view of both the ocean and the eastern end of Fortune’s Keep, while farther up you’ll find a small village area including access to the tallest section of the cliff. Claiming this area offers great map control in the vicinity, so long as the gas hasn’t cleared the place out yet.[/p][p] [/p][p]Town[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d7dfecc39f899bb1918d2db014126951a461b557.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Operators seeking close-quarters, urban combat should head into Town along the map’s western shore. A treasure trove a loot awaits within its tightly packed layout, so long as you’re prepared to engage enemies at a moment’s notice and often face to face. Its lower elevation makes the area susceptible to attacks from the outside, so be on the lookout for enemy forces when it’s time to exit the area.[/p][p] [/p][p]Graveyard[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4334c93ee1f02c780b11667ef4a1510b981c1562.jpg"][/img][/p][p]There’s little cover here, but the tombs and outer walls do provide some cover in a pinch. There’s a steep drop off to the shore here, so beware of enemy squads attempting a flanking attack from the west. Within the Graveyard, look for the easternmost sepulcher providing access to a belowground passageway. If you prefer a clear view, climb the stairs to the top of the nearby round tower.[/p][p] [/p][p]Grotto[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/92e38e32438a9d449c29ba73c5561b02349b20cb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Get way below the action in the Grotto, positioned at the base of the cliffs with access to several cave systems leading to other parts of the map like the Lighthouse and the Graveyard. Getting to these cave systems requires landing safely and fighting any enemy squads within the Grotto or directly above on the surface.[/p][p] [/p][p]Smuggler’s Cove[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/db890d8a6b3c1a6fb46c27fc432c2bbb402fcd28.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Secluded from the main island, Smuggler’s Cove upholds its reputation for stockpiling illegally sourced cargo within the deep-sea caves. The shallow waters somewhat limit mobility, so seek out an elevated position when possible. For a quick escape, back up into the cave systems of the nearby Grotto or use the area’s system of ladders, walkways, and Ascenders to reclaim the high ground.[/p][p] [/p][p]Research Vessel[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d38397073857dfac0db935621ac8621dba4bff4f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This pontoon-style watercraft circles the shoreline of Fortune’s Keep in the opening minutes of the match before eventually dropping anchor. The multi-level POI is equipped with a Buy Station, Ammo Cache, UAV Tower, and a limited use POI wide gas decontamination system. It’s the only POI on Fortune’s Keep that maintains a UAV Tower which makes it an incredibly desirable location for tracking enemy movement. When inland, watch for snipers firing from the deck.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Micro POI Updates[/h3][p] [/p][p]Sea Science Aquatic Laboratory[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b9751ae3ad4654c5fc4f9e8bb0557f716c9a6171.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Head to the Bay POI to visit Sea Science Aquatic Laboratory located right on the boat launch. The two-story building features the latest in marine research, though in the midst of battle, keep your eyes peeled for enemies making their way into the main structure. With a staircase on either side and an assortment of tightly packed rooms, combat can erupt at any moment.[/p][p][/p][p]For a simpler cover point, move into one of the smaller research center outbuildings, one positioned on the water by the boat launch ramp and the other above the main building for a more elevated vantage point. [/p][p] [/p][p]Capt. Bubby’s Chum Haus[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c66e8e7df5d69f77d57077bdd68c073e44e11a75.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Between the Pier and Lighthouse now stands the fast-food restaurant, Capt. Bubby’s Chum Haus. Stop in for some grub straight from the shoreline, from Bubby’s Up-Chunk Chowder to Smothered Seagull Cutlet. The one-story building marks a strong cover point in the area. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/887b4b0f6c08ba5f52fff33e6e61842018a5c834.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Fire out the windows on enemy targets in the surrounding lot or get behind the service counter for defending against enemies attempting to breach the building.[/p][p] [/p][p]Smuggler HQ[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e1b4eda4c41b00a821e066a9cc87562ea077157a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Positioned right near the opening of the Grotto near the Gatehouse, the Smuggler HQ offers a valuable looting and cover point positioned right in the center of the map. Use the cluster of buildings and shipping containers to get out of sight from the main roads, resupply, and ambush unsuspecting passersby. The centrally located POI offers a great pivot point toward other areas of the map, whether your squad’s planning an attack toward the northern Keep or elsewhere on the island.[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h3]New Modes and Weekend LTMS (Launch, Mid-Season)[/h3][p] [/p][p]Clash (Launch)[/p][p][i]52v52, Verdansk, Returning[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/61c2144149030a721793d41d07da1739baa04757.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]Prepare for a largescale team skirmish in the 52v52 Clash Mode, with the battle location taking place in one of nine POIs within Verdansk, including the returning POIs Farm, Promenade East, Quarry, and Boneyard plus five new Clash zones in Airport, Signal Station, Launch Pad, Port, and Factory.[/p][p] [/p][p]The first team to reach the point limit — or whoever has the highest point total when the match timer runs out — wins the game, with points being allocated as such:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]Earn 1 point per elimination.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Earn 10 points per completed Contract.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Earn 20 points per each bonus crate capture.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Earn 40 points per each Domination point capture.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Get the advantage any way you can, from seeking out vehicles including the new LTV mid-sized truck equipped with a turret, completing Contracts for points and in-match rewards, and building up your cash reserves for Buy Station purchases like the Death Machine, D.A.W.G., and, when it’s time to bring in the big guns, the VTOL Warship. Work with your squad and the greater team to push the fight, capture Domination points, and grind the enemy forces into the dirt.[/p][p] [/p][p]Squad Gun Game (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Resurgence Maps[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Experience Gun Game in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] for the first time ever as squads drop into Resurgence maps with the objective of being the first to cycle through a pre-determined number of weapons. newsitems.title: The International 2026 Ticket Sales
newsitems.author: kyled
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3703047/882f6398bbe0c283cb33d57a3c18160c5d5a9f00.png[/img]

In just a few short months, the finest Dota teams in the world will gather in Shanghai to battle for the Aegis of Champions in front of thousands of cheering fans. We've announced [url=https://www.dota2.com/newsentry/655981180194128453]the official team invitations[/url], and now we'd like to extend one to you. If you want to be one of those fans cheering live at the arena, it's time to get ready: ticket sales for The International 2026 kick off on June 10th at 2pm China Standard Time.

The in-arena action runs from August 20 - 23 at the SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center, with two ticket options available: single-day tickets for any day, or two-day bundles covering Thursday/Friday and Saturday/Sunday. All seating this year will be assigned, with no General Admission options available.

Ticket prices vary based on day and section, so check out the full chart of options below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/eeda1e52cc7d32f4c0db01e2ed4f7ff409a95c4f.png[/img]

There are two purchase paths this year: one for fans purchasing domestically within China, and another for purchasing internationally.

[h2]China Domestic Sales[/h2]
Chinese domestic ticket sales will be available through [url=https://m.damai.cn/shows/item.html?itemId=1052581844801]Damai[/url] or the Perfect World app, and will require a Chinese ID to complete any sale.

Once ticket sales begin on June 10th at 2pm (China Standard Time), the first twenty minutes will serve as a priority purchase period for domestic tickets. During this period, purchases are restricted to active Dota players in China who have played at least ten games in within the last six months. (To be eligible for priority purchase, please [url=https://www.dota2.com.cn/international/2026/ticketspriority]verify your account status[/url] in advance by the end of Wednesday, June 3, 2026.)

From 2:30pm (CST) onward, domestic tickets will be available for purchase to all Chinese customers.

[h2]International Sales[/h2]
For fans purchasing outside of China, ticket sales will commence on June 10th at 2:30pm (CST) via [url=https://www.trip.com/t/TI2026]Trip.com[/url].

[h1]FAQ[/h1]

[b]How does seating work?[/b]
Tickets are purchased for a specific seating region (see chart above). After your purchase, you will be assigned a specific seat in the region you selected. All seats are assigned and reserved. [i]There are no general admission tickets or seats.[/i]

[b]What is the ticket transfer policy?[/b]
Tickets cannot be transferred, gifted, or resold. Tickets can only be used by the names for which they were purchased.

[b]What do I need to purchase tickets internationally?[/b]
Trip.com requires an account and a valid passport for international ticket purchases. You can create your account and submit attendee documentation before tickets go on sale.

[b]Can I purchase tickets for my group?[/b]
Yes, but note that the ticketing platforms limit each individual account to a maximum of two tickets per day. Multiple transactions may be required depending on the size of your group and how many days you wish to attend. As noted above, each attendee/ticket holder must have proper identification in order to complete the checkout process.

[b]Do I need to bring anything else besides my tickets to enter the event?[/b]
Event entrance requires a valid photo ID matching the name on the ticket.

[b]What is the ticket refund policy?[/b]
For China domestic ticket sales, please see the [url=https://m.damai.cn/shows/item.html?itemId=1052581844801]Damai refund policy[/url]. For international ticket sales, please see the [url=https://www.trip.com/t/TI2026]Trip.com refund policy[/url].

newsitems.author: brianlev
newsitems.contents:
The IEM Cologne 2026 Major is fast approaching. Teams are making final adjustments, fine-tuning their strats, and crossing their fingers that they won't face Vitality until the Grand Final. That can only mean one thing: Tournament Items featuring Teams and Player Autographs are now available for purchase!

[h3]The 2026 Cologne Major Shop[/h3]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/8f7212f18c038fcecaa6c96cfeb9785f14d74489.png[/img]
The Major Shop has undergone some major renovation--now you can directly get any sticker you want (at prices set by demand). Holo Furia logo? You got it. Foil Donk autograph? No problem. 

You can purchase tokens and redeem them for any sticker you want. The prices of stickers will depend on relative demand (when lots of players buy a particular sticker, its price goes up and other sticker prices go down), but if you're worried that a sticker might drop in price right after you buy it, we've got you covered. If a sticker price drops by more than 25 tokens within 24 hours of your purchase you'll get a refund of tokens for the total difference.

Details about the Major Shop renovation and how this all works can be found in the FAQ below.

[h3]Souvenir-O-Matic[/h3]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/8b98a1ee99bd0178265c42624a4ee8d41ac91768.png[/img]
What will you bring to the signing session? Now you can craft your own Souvenir! Take any normal or Souvenir quality weapon in your inventory and select a completed match and one of the players. You'll get your weapon back in Souvenir quality with gold team, autograph, and map stickers applied.

[h3]Pick'Em[/h3]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/b50091a00523a82121c1e9707ca7a92276d21349.png[/img]
Purchase and activate a Cologne 2026 Viewer Pass, and you'll receive a 2026 Cologne Major Challenge Coin. Play the Pick'Em Challenge to upgrade your Challenge Coin from Bronze to Silver, Gold, or Diamond and with each upgrade you'll get 300 tokens that you can redeem for the stickers or souvenirs of your choice.

[h3]Supporting the Teams[/h3]
As with previous Majors, 50% of the tournament item sales are shared with the Tournament Organizer, Teams, and Players. But this time the royalty rates depend on performance. Between now and the end of the Major royalty rates for token sales are based on the teams' VRS seeding, and after the Major the royalty rates will be based on the Major final standings. The breakdown is in the FAQ, below.

So clear your schedule and tune in, as the Major returns to the Cathedral of Counter-Strike!

[h2]FAQ[/h2]

[h5]Q. Why aren't you selling capsules?[/h5]
In the past we shipped team and player autograph stickers in capsules. While this approach was popular, we've heard feedback that players might prefer to purchase stickers directly. Additionally, players in certain regions cannot purchase sticker capsules. So we're exploring alternatives that allow all players to participate.

[h5]Q. How do I get tournament items?[/h5]
Add any sticker or stickers you like to your cart, and check out. To complete your transaction, first you'll purchase and activate tokens, and then redeem those tokens for your sticker.

Sticker purchases are final and cannot be refunded. If you cancel your transaction before activating your tokens, those tokens _can_ be refunded. If you cancel your transaction after activating your tokens, the tokens will remain in your balance (and cannot be refunded) but you can redeem them for something else.

[h5]Q. How are sticker prices set?[/h5]
The prices of all stickers depend on relative demand. This means that if one sticker is purchased disproportionately more than another, its price will go up and the other sticker's price will go down. After a large number of stickers are sold, all sticker prices will update (you'll get a warning if you're shopping when this is about to happen). The prices in tokens you see are the same prices for everyone worldwide.

[h5]Q. Why do I have to purchase tokens?[/h5]
Tokens are a little less convenient than just paying for stickers outright. But the reality is that if stickers could be refunded after being purchased, then the sticker prices would not accurately represent real demand.

[h5]Q. Can I pre-purchase tokens?[/h5]
No. Tokens are only purchased when you're buying stickers and do not already have enough tokens in your balance. In that case, you'll be asked to purchase the exact number of tokens required (minimum 100, which is $0.99 USD) to complete your transaction.

[h5]Q. What if the sticker price goes down after I redeem my tokens?[/h5]
If the price of any redeemed sticker decreases by 25 tokens or more within the next 24 hours, we'll automatically issue you a refund of tokens for the difference between your redemption price and the lowest price in that period. Refunds are automatically credited to your tokens balance after one week.

[h5]Q. How do souvenirs work this time?[/h5]
Take any weapon of normal or souvenir quality in your inventory and select a completed match and one of the players from that match. You'll permanently convert that weapon into a Souvenir with gold team, autograph, and map stickers applied. You will have a chance to see a preview of your souvenir before you complete your purchase.

If the weapon had any existing stickers, they will be removed before you craft your souvenir.

[h5]Q. How are souvenir prices determined?[/h5]
Souvenir prices are determined by two factors: the demand for the specific gold team and autograph stickers involved, and the rarity of the weapon you choose for your souvenir.

[h5]Q. How are royalties shared among the tournament organizer, teams and players?[/h5]
50% of total Major Shop and Major Pass revenue is shared as royalties with the tournament organizer, teams, and players. The chart below shows how that 50% is distributed. Note that for each team position, half of the royalties are shared with the team organization, and the other half is split equally among the five players.

Between now and the grand final, royalties are shared based on the teams' global VRS leading into the event. After the grand final, royalties will be shared based on the final standings.
